1.text: Dese be tha words which Moses spoke 2 all Israel on dis side Jordan in tha wilderness, in tha plain over against tha Red sea, between Paran, N Tophel, N Laban, N Hazeroth, N Dizahab.
( There r eleven days’ journey from Horeb by tha way of mount Seir 2 Kadesh-barnea.)
N it happened in tha fortieth year, in tha eleventh month, on tha first day of tha month, dat Moses spoke 2 tha children of Israel, according 2 all dat tha LORD had given him in commandment 2 ’em;
After he had killed Sihon tha king of tha Amorites, which lived in Heshbon, N Og tha king of Bashan, which lived at Astaroth in Edrei:
On dis side Jordan, in tha land of Moab, began Moses 2 declare dis law, sayin,
Tha LORD our God spoke 2 us in Horeb, sayin, y’all have lived long enough in dis mount:

Turn u, N take ur journey, N go 2 tha mount of tha Amorites, N 2 all tha places nigh thereunto, in tha plain, in tha hills, N in tha vale, N in tha south, N by tha sea side, 2 tha land of tha Canaanites, N 2 Lebanon, 2 tha great river, tha river Euphrates.
Look, I have set tha land before u: go in N possess tha land which tha LORD sware 2 ur fathers, Abraham, Isaac, N Jacob, 2 give 2 ’em N 2 their seed after ’em.
N I spoke 2 u at dat time, sayin, I am not able 2 bear u myself alone:
Tha LORD ur God has multiplied u, N, look, y’all r dis day as tha stars of heaven 4 crowd.
(tha LORD God of ur fathers make u a thousand times so many more as y’all r, N bless u, as he has promised u!)
How can I myself alone bear ur cumbrance, N ur burden, N ur strife?
Take u wise men, N understanding, N known among ur tribes, N I will make ’em rulers over u.
N y’all answered me, N said, tha thing which u have spoken is good 4 us 2 do.

So I took tha chief of ur tribes, wise men, N known, N made ’em heads over u, captains over thousands, N captains over hundreds, N captains over fifties, N captains over tens, N officers among ur tribes.
N I charged ur judges at dat time, sayin, Hear tha causes between ur brothers, N judge righteously between every man N his brother, N tha stranger dat is wit him.

y’all shall not respect persons in judgment; but y’all shall hear tha small as well as tha great; y’all shall not be afraid of tha face of man; 4 tha judgment is God’s: N tha cause dat is too hard 4 u, bring it 2 me, N I will hear it.
N I commanded u at dat time all tha things which y’all should do.

N when we departed from Horeb, we went through all dat great N terrible wilderness, which y’all saw by tha way of tha mountain of tha Amorites, as tha LORD our God commanded us; N we came 2 Kadesh-barnea.
N I said 2 u, y’all r come 2 tha mountain of tha Amorites, which tha LORD our God does give 2 us.
Look, tha LORD ur God has set tha land before u: go up N possess it, as tha LORD God of ur fathers has said 2 u; don’t fear, neither be discouraged.
N y’all came near 2 me every one of u, N said, We will send men before us, N dey shall search us out tha land, N bring us word again by what way we must go up, N in2 what citiez we shall come.
N tha sayin pleased me well: N I took twelve men of u, one of a tribe:
N dey turned N went up in2 tha mountain, N came 2 tha valley of Eshcol, N searched it out.
N dey took of tha fruit of tha land in their hands, N brought it down 2 us, N brought us word again, N said, It is a good land which tha LORD our God does give us.
Even so y’all would not go up, but rebelled against tha commandment of tha LORD ur God:
N y’all grumbled in ur tents, N said, Because tha LORD hated us, he has brought us forth out of tha land of Egypt, 2 deliver us in2 tha hand of tha Amorites, 2 destroy us.

Where shall we go up? our brothers have discouraged our heart, sayin, tha people is greater N taller than we; tha citiez r great N walled up 2 heaven; N moreover we have seen tha sons of tha Anakims there.
Then I said 2 u, Dread not, neither be afraid of ’em.
Tha LORD ur God which goes before u, he shall fight 4 u, according 2 all dat he did 4 u in Egypt before ur eyes;
N in tha wilderness, where u have seen how dat tha LORD ur God bare u, as a man does bear his son, in all tha way dat y’all went, until y’all came in2 dis place.
Yet in dis thing y’all did not believe tha LORD ur God,
Who went in tha way before u, 2 search u out a place 2 pitch ur tents in, in fire by night, 2 show u by what way y’all should go, N in a cloud by day.
N tha LORD heard tha voice of ur words, N was angry, N sware, sayin,
Surely there shall not one of dese men of dis evil generation see dat good land, which I sware 2 give 2 ur fathers,
Save Caleb tha son of Jephunneh; he shall see it, N 2 him will I give tha land dat he has trodden upon, N 2 his children, because he has wholly followed tha LORD.
Also tha LORD was angry wit me 4 ur sakes, sayin, u also will not go in there.
But Joshua tha son of Nun, which stands before u, he shall go in there: encourage him: 4 he shall cause Israel 2 inherit it.

Moreover ur little ones, which y’all said should be a prey, N ur children, which in dat day had no knowledge between good N evil, dey shall go in there, N 2 ’em will I give it, N dey shall possess it.
But as 4 u, turn u, N take ur journey in2 tha wilderness by tha way of tha Red sea.

Then y’all answered 2 me, We have sinned against tha LORD, we will go up N fight, according 2 all dat tha LORD our God commanded us. N when y’all had girded on every man his weapons of war, y’all were ready 2 go up in2 tha hill.
N tha LORD said 2 me, Say 2 ’em, Go not up, neither fight; 4 I am not among u; lest y’all be struck before ur opps.
So I spoke 2 u; N y’all would not hear, but rebelled against tha commandment of tha LORD, N went presumptuously up in2 tha hill.
N tha Amorites, which lived in dat mountain, came out against u, N chased u, as bees do, N destroyed u in Seir, even 2 Hormah.
N y’all returned N wept before tha LORD; but tha LORD would not listen 2 ur voice, nor listen up 2 u.
So y’all stayed in Kadesh many days, according 2 tha days dat y’all stayed there.

2.text: Then we turned, N took our journey in2 tha wilderness by tha way of tha Red sea, as tha LORD spoke 2 me: N we compassed mount Seir many days.
N tha LORD spoke 2 me, sayin,
y’all have compassed dis mountain long enough: turn u northward.
N command u tha people, sayin, y’all r 2 pass through tha coast of ur brothers tha children of Esau, which live in Seir; N dey shall be afraid of u: take y’all good heed 2 y’all therefore:
Meddle not wit ’em; 4 I will not give u of their land, no, not so much as a foot breadth; because I have given mount Seir 2 Esau 4 a possession.
y’all shall buy food of ’em 4 money, dat y’all may eat; N y’all shall also buy water of ’em 4 money, dat y’all may drink.
4 tha LORD ur God has blessed u in all tha works of ur hand: he knows ur walkin through dis great wilderness: dese forty years tha LORD ur God has been wit u; u have lacked nothing.
N when we passed by from our brothers tha children of Esau, which lived in Seir, through tha way of tha plain from Elath, N from Ezion-gaber, we turned N passed by tha way of tha wilderness of Moab.
N tha LORD said 2 me, Distress not tha Moabites, neither contend wit ’em in battle: 4 I will not give u of their land 4 a possession; because I have given Ar 2 tha children of Lot 4 a possession.
Tha Emims lived in it in times past, a people great, N many, N tall, as tha Anakims;
Which also were accounted giants, as tha Anakims; but tha Moabites call ’em Emims.

Tha Horims also lived in Seir beforetime; but tha children of Esau succeeded ’em, when dey had destroyed ’em from before ’em, N lived in their stead; as Israel did 2 tha land of his possession, which tha LORD gave 2 ’em.
Now rise up, said I, N get u over tha brook Zered. N we went over tha brook Zered.

N tha space in which we came from Kadesh-barnea, until we were come over tha brook Zered, was thirty N eight years; until all tha generation of tha men of war were wasted out from among tha host, as tha LORD sware 2 ’em.
4 indeed tha hand of tha LORD was against ’em, 2 destroy ’em from among tha host, until dey were consumed.
So it happened, when all tha men of war were consumed N dead from among tha people,
Dat tha LORD spoke 2 me, sayin,
u r 2 pass over through Ar, tha coast of Moab, dis day:

N when u come nigh over against tha children of Ammon, distress ’em not, nor meddle wit ’em: 4 I will not give u of tha land of tha children of Ammon any possession; because I have given it 2 tha children of Lot 4 a possession.
(dat also was accounted a land of giants: giants lived in it in old time; N tha Ammonites call ’em Zamzummims;
A people great, N many, N tall, as tha Anakims; but tha LORD destroyed ’em before ’em; N dey succeeded ’em, N lived in their stead:
As he did 2 tha children of Esau, which lived in Seir, when he destroyed tha Horims from before ’em; N dey succeeded ’em, N lived in their stead even 2 dis day:
N tha Avims which lived in Hazerim, even 2 Azzah, tha Caphtorims, which came forth out of Caphtor, destroyed ’em, N lived in their stead.)
Rise y’all up, take ur journey, N pass over tha river Arnon: look, I have given in2 thine hand Sihon tha Amorite, king of Heshbon, N his land: begin 2 possess it, N contend wit him in battle.
Dis day will I begin 2 put tha dread of u N tha fear of u upon tha nations dat r under tha whole heaven, who shall hear report of u, N shall tremble, N be in anguish because of u.
N I sent messengers out of tha wilderness of Kedemoth 2 Sihon king of Heshbon wit words of peace, sayin,
Let me pass through ur land: I will go along by tha high way, I will neither turn 2 tha right hand nor 2 tha left.
u will sell me food 4 money, dat I may eat; N give me water 4 money, dat I may drink: only I will pass through on my feet;
(As tha children of Esau which live in Seir, N tha Moabites which live in Ar, did 2 me;) until I shall pass over Jordan in2 tha land which tha LORD our God gives us.
But Sihon king of Heshbon would not let us pass by him: 4 tha LORD ur God hardened his spirit, N made his heart obstinate, dat he might deliver him in2 ur hand, as appears dis day.
N tha LORD said 2 me, look, I have begun 2 give Sihon N his land before u: begin 2 possess, dat u may inherit his land.
Then Sihon came out against us, he N all his people, 2 fight at Jahaz.
N tha LORD our God delivered him before us; N we struck him, N his sons, N all his people.
N we took all his citiez at dat time, N utterly destroyed tha men, N tha women, N tha little ones, of every city, we left none 2 remain:
Only tha cattle we took 4 a prey 2 ourselves, N tha spoil of tha citiez which we took.
From Aroer, which is by tha brink of tha river of Arnon, N from tha city dat is by tha river, even 2 Gilead, there was not one city too strong 4 us: tha LORD our God delivered all 2 us:
Only 2 tha land of tha children of Ammon u came not, nor 2 any place of tha river Jabbok, nor 2 tha citiez in tha mountains, nor 2 whatever tha LORD our God forbad us.

3.text: Then we turned, N went up tha way 2 Bashan: N Og tha king of Bashan came out against us, he N all his people, 2 battle at Edrei.
N tha LORD said 2 me, Fear him not: 4 I will deliver him, N all his people, N his land, in2 ur hand; N u will do 2 him as u did 2 Sihon king of tha Amorites, which lived at Heshbon.
So tha LORD our God delivered in2 our hands Og also, tha king of Bashan, N all his people: N we struck him until none was left 2 him remaining.
N we took all his citiez at dat time, there was not a city which we took not from ’em, threescore citiez, all tha region of Argob, tha kingdom of Og in Bashan.
All dese citiez were fenced wit high walls, gates, N bars; beside unwalled towns a great many.
N we utterly destroyed ’em, as we did 2 Sihon king of Heshbon, utterly destroying tha men, women, N children, of every city.
But all tha cattle, N tha spoil of tha citiez, we took 4 a prey 2 ourselves.
N we took at dat time out of tha hand of tha two kings of tha Amorites tha land dat was on dis side Jordan, from tha river of Arnon 2 mount Hermon;
( Which Hermon tha Sidonians call Sirion; N tha Amorites call it Shenir;)
All tha citiez of tha plain, N all Gilead, N all Bashan, 2 Salchah N Edrei, citiez of tha kingdom of Og in Bashan.

4 only Og king of Bashan remained of tha remnant of giants; look, his bedstead was a bedstead of iron; is it not in Rabbath of tha children of Ammon? nine cubits was tha length of it, N four cubits tha breadth of it, after tha cubit of a man.
N dis land, which we possessed at dat time, from Aroer, which is by tha river Arnon, N half mount Gilead, N tha citiez of it, gave I 2 tha Reubenites N 2 tha Gadites.
N tha rest of Gilead, N all Bashan, bein tha kingdom of Og, gave I 2 tha half tribe of Manasseh; all tha region of Argob, wit all Bashan, which was called tha land of giants.
Jair tha son of Manasseh took all tha country of Argob 2 tha coasts of Geshuri N Maachathi; N called ’em after his own name, Bashan-havoth-jair, 2 dis day.
N I gave Gilead 2 Machir.
N 2 tha Reubenites N 2 tha Gadites I gave from Gilead even 2 tha river Arnon half tha valley, N tha border even 2 tha river Jabbok, which is tha border of tha children of Ammon;
Tha plain also, N Jordan, N tha coast of it, from Chinnereth even 2 tha sea of tha plain, even tha salt sea, under Ashdoth-pisgah eastward.
N I commanded u at dat time, sayin, tha LORD ur God has given u dis land 2 possess it: y’all shall pass over armed before ur brothers tha children of Israel, all dat r meet 4 tha war.
But ur wives, N ur little ones, N ur cattle, ( 4 I know dat y’all have much cattle,) shall abide in ur citiez which I have given u;

Until tha LORD have given rest 2 ur brothers, as well as 2 u, N until dey also possess tha land which tha LORD ur God has given ’em beyond Jordan: N then shall y’all return every man 2 his possession, which I have given u.
N I commanded Joshua at dat time, sayin, ur eyes have seen all dat tha LORD ur God has done 2 dese two kings: so shall tha LORD do 2 all tha kingdoms where u pass.
y’all shall not fear ’em: 4 tha LORD ur God he shall fight 4 u.
N I besought tha LORD at dat time, sayin,
O Lord GOD, u have begun 2 show ur servant ur greatness, N ur mighty hand: 4 what God is there in heaven or in earth, dat can do according 2 ur works, N according 2 ur might?
I pray u, let me go over, N see tha good land dat is beyond Jordan, dat goodly mountain, N Lebanon.
But tha LORD was angry wit me 4 ur sakes, N would not hear me: N tha LORD said 2 me, Let it suffice u; speak no more 2 me of dis matter.
Get u up in2 tha top of Pisgah, N lift up ur eyes westward, N northward, N southward, N eastward, N look it wit ur eyes: 4 u will not go over dis Jordan.
But charge Joshua, N encourage him, N strengthen him: 4 he shall go over before dis people, N he shall cause ’em 2 inherit tha land which u will see.
So we stayed in tha valley over against Beth-peor.

4.text: Now therefore listen, O Israel, 2 tha statutes N 2 tha judgments, which I teach u, 4 2 do ’em, dat y’all may live, N go in N possess tha land which tha LORD God of ur fathers gives u.
y’all shall not add 2 tha word which I command u, neither shall y’all diminish ought from it, dat y’all may keep tha commandments of tha LORD ur God which I command u.
Ur eyes have seen what tha LORD did because of Baal-peor: 4 all tha men dat followed Baal-peor, tha LORD ur God has destroyed ’em from among u.
But y’all dat did cleave 2 tha LORD ur God r alive every one of u dis day.
Look, I have taught u statutes N judgments, even as tha LORD my God commanded me, dat y’all should do so in tha land where y’all go 2 possess it.
Keep therefore N do ’em; 4 dis is ur wisdom N ur understanding in tha sight of tha nations, which shall hear all dese statutes, N say, Surely dis great nation is a wise N understanding people.
4 what nation is there so great, who has God so nigh 2 ’em, as tha LORD our God is in all things dat we call upon him 4?
N what nation is there so great, dat has statutes N judgments so righteous as all dis law, which I set before u dis day?

Only pay attention 2 urself, N keep ur soul diligently, lest u forget tha things which ur eyes have seen, N lest dey depart from ur heart all tha days of ur life: but teach ’em ur sons, N ur sons’ sons;

Specially tha day dat u stoodest before tha LORD ur God in Horeb, when tha LORD said 2 me, Gather me tha people together, N I will make ’em hear my words, dat dey may learn 2 fear me all tha days dat dey shall live upon tha earth, N dat dey may teach their children.
N y’all came near N stood under tha mountain; N tha mountain burned wit fire 2 tha midst of heaven, wit darkness, clouds, N thick darkness.
N tha LORD spoke 2 u out of tha midst of tha fire: y’all heard tha voice of tha words, but saw no similitude; only y’all heard a voice.
N he declared 2 u his covenant, which he commanded u 2 perform, even ten commandments; N he wrote ’em upon two tables of stone.
N tha LORD commanded me at dat time 2 teach u statutes N judgments, dat y’all might do ’em in tha land where y’all go over 2 possess it.
Take y’all therefore good heed 2 y’all; 4 y’all saw no manner of similitude on tha day dat tha LORD spoke 2 u in Horeb out of tha midst of tha fire:
Lest y’all corrupt y’all, N make u a graven image, tha similitude of any figure, tha likeness of male or female,
Tha likeness of any beast dat is on tha earth, tha likeness of any winged fowl dat flieth in tha air,
Tha likeness of any thing dat creeps on tha ground, tha likeness of any fish dat is in tha waterz beneath tha earth:

N lest u lift up ur eyes 2 heaven, N when u see tha sun, N tha moon, N tha stars, even all tha host of heaven, should be driven 2 worship ’em, N serve ’em, which tha LORD ur God has divided 2 all nations under tha whole heaven.
But tha LORD has taken u, N brought u forth out of tha iron furnace, even out of Egypt, 2 be 2 him a people of inheritance, as y’all r dis day.
Furthermore tha LORD was angry wit me 4 ur sakes, N sware dat I should not go over Jordan, N dat I should not go in 2 dat good land, which tha LORD ur God gives u 4 an inheritance:
But I must die in dis land, I must not go over Jordan: but y’all shall go over, N possess dat good land.
Pay attention 2 y’all, lest y’all forget tha covenant of tha LORD ur God, which he made wit u, N make u a graven image, or tha likeness of any thing, which tha LORD ur God has forbidden u.
4 tha LORD ur God is a consuming fire, even a jealous God.

When u will beget children, N children’s children, N y’all shall have remained long in tha land, N shall corrupt y’all, N make a graven image, or tha likeness of any thing, N shall do evil in tha sight of tha LORD ur God, 2 provoke him 2 anger:

I call heaven N earth 2 witness against u dis day, dat y’all shall soon utterly perish from off tha land whereunto y’all go over Jordan 2 possess it; y’all shall not prolong ur days upon it, but shall utterly be destroyed.
N tha LORD shall scatter u among tha nations, N y’all shall be left few in number among tha heathen, where tha LORD shall lead u.
N there y’all shall serve gods, tha work of men’s hands, wood N stone, which neither see, nor hear, nor eat, nor smell.
But if from thence u will seek tha LORD ur God, u will find him, if u seek him wit all ur heart N wit all ur soul.
When u r in tribulation, N all dese things r come upon u, even in tha latter days, if u turn 2 tha LORD ur God, N will be obedient 2 his voice;
(4 tha LORD ur God is a merciful God;) he will not forsake u, neither destroy u, nor forget tha covenant of ur fathers which he sware 2 ’em.

4 ask now of tha days dat r past, which were before u, since tha day dat God created man upon tha earth, N ask from tha one side of heaven 2 tha other, whether there has been any such thing as dis great thing is, or has been heard like it?
Did ever people hear tha voice of God speakin out of tha midst of tha fire, as u have heard, N live?

Or has God assayed 2 go N take him a nation from tha midst of another nation, by temptations, by signs, N by wonders, N by war, N by a mighty hand, N by a stretched out arm, N by great terrors, according 2 all dat tha LORD ur God did 4 u in Egypt before ur eyes?
2 u it was showed, dat u might know dat tha LORD he is God; there is none else beside him.
Out of heaven he made u 2 hear his voice, dat he might instruct u: N upon earth he showed u his great fire; N u heard his words out of tha midst of tha fire.
N because he loved ur fathers, therefore he chose their seed after ’em, N brought u out in his sight wit his mighty power out of Egypt;
2 drive out nations from before u greater N mightier than u r, 2 bring u in, 2 give u their land 4 an inheritance, as it is dis day.
Know therefore dis day, N consider it in thine heart, dat tha LORD he is God in heaven above, N upon tha earth beneath: there is none else.

u will keep therefore his statutes, N his commandments, which I command u dis day, dat it may go well wit u, N wit ur children after u, N dat u may prolong ur days upon tha earth, which tha LORD ur God gives u, 4 ever.
Then Moses severed three citiez on dis side Jordan toward tha sunrising;
Dat tha slayer might flee there, which should kill his neighbour unawares, N hated him not in times past; N dat fleein 2 one of dese citiez he might live:
Namely, Bezer in tha wilderness, in tha plain country, of tha Reubenites; N Ramoth in Gilead, of tha Gadites; N Golan in Bashan, of tha Manassites.
N dis is tha law which Moses set before tha children of Israel:
Dese r tha testimonies, N tha statutes, N tha judgments, which Moses spoke 2 tha children of Israel, after dey came forth out of Egypt,

On dis side Jordan, in tha valley over against Beth-peor, in tha land of Sihon king of tha Amorites, who lived at Heshbon, whom Moses N tha children of Israel struck, after dey were come forth out of Egypt:
N dey possessed his land, N tha land of Og king of Bashan, two kings of tha Amorites, which were on dis side Jordan toward tha sunrising;
From Aroer, which is by tha bank of tha river Arnon, even 2 mount Sion, which is Hermon,
N all tha plain on dis side Jordan eastward, even 2 tha sea of tha plain, under tha springs of Pisgah.

5.text: N Moses called all Israel, N said 2 ’em, Hear, O Israel, tha statutes N judgments which I speak in ur ears dis day, dat y’all may learn ’em, N keep, N do ’em.
Tha LORD our God made a covenant wit us in Horeb.
Tha LORD made not dis covenant wit our fathers, but wit us, even us, who r all of us here alive dis day.
Tha LORD talked wit u face 2 face in tha mount out of tha midst of tha fire,
(I stood between tha LORD N u at dat time, 2 show u tha word of tha LORD: 4 y’all were afraid by reason of tha fire, N went not up in2 tha mount;) sayin,
I am tha LORD ur God, which brought u out of tha land of Egypt, from tha house of bondage.
u will have none other gods before me.
u will not make u any graven image, or any likeness of any thing dat is in heaven above, or dat is in tha earth beneath, or dat is in tha waterz beneath tha earth:
u will not bow down urself 2 ’em, nor serve ’em: 4 I tha LORD ur God am a jealous God, visiting tha iniquity of tha fathers upon tha children 2 tha third N fourth generation of ’em dat hate me,
N shewing mercy 2 thousands of ’em dat love me N keep my commandments.
u will not take tha name of tha LORD ur God in vain: 4 tha LORD will not hold him guiltless dat takes his name in vain.
Keep tha sabbath day 2 sanctify it, as tha LORD ur God has commanded u.
Six days u will labour, N do all ur work:

But tha seventh day is tha sabbath of tha LORD ur God: in it u will not do any work, u, nor ur son, nor ur daughter, nor ur manservant, nor ur maidservant, nor thine ox, nor thine ass, nor any of ur cattle, nor ur stranger dat is within ur gates; dat ur manservant N ur maidservant may rest as well as u.

N remember dat u were a servant in tha land of Egypt, N dat tha LORD ur God brought u out thence through a mighty hand N by a stretched out arm: therefore tha LORD ur God commanded u 2 keep tha sabbath day.
Honour ur father N ur mother, as tha LORD ur God has commanded u; dat ur days may be prolonged, N dat it may go well wit u, in tha land which tha LORD ur God gives u.
u will not kill.
Neither will u commit adultery.
Neither will u steal.
Neither will u bear false witness against ur neighbour.
Neither will u desire ur neighbour’s wife, neither will u covet ur neighbour’s house, his field, or his manservant, or his maidservant, his ox, or his ass, or any thing dat is ur neighbour’s.

Dese words tha LORD spoke 2 all ur assembly in tha mount out of tha midst of tha fire, of tha cloud, N of tha thick darkness, wit a great voice: N he added no more. N he wrote ’em in two tables of stone, N delivered ’em 2 me.
N it happened, when y’all heard tha voice out of tha midst of tha darkness, (4 tha mountain did burn wit fire,) dat y’all came near 2 me, even all tha heads of ur tribes, N ur elders;
N y’all said, look, tha LORD our God has showed us his glory N his greatness, N we have heard his voice out of tha midst of tha fire: we have seen dis day dat God does talk wit man, N he lives.
Now therefore why should we die? 4 dis great fire will consume us: if we hear tha voice of tha LORD our God any more, then we shall die.
4 who is there of all flesh, dat has heard tha voice of tha livin God speakin out of tha midst of tha fire, as we have, N lived?
Go u near, N hear all dat tha LORD our God shall say: N speak u 2 us all dat tha LORD our God shall speak 2 u; N we will hear it, N do it.

N tha LORD heard tha voice of ur words, when y’all spoke 2 me; N tha LORD said 2 me, I have heard tha voice of tha words of dis people, which dey have spoken 2 u: dey have well said all dat dey have spoken.
O dat there were such an heart in ’em, dat dey would fear me, N keep all my commandments always, dat it might be well wit ’em, N wit their children 4 ever!
Go say 2 ’em, Get u in2 ur tents again.
But as 4 u, stand u here by me, N I will speak 2 u all tha commandments, N tha statutes, N tha judgments, which u will teach ’em, dat dey may do ’em in tha land which I give ’em 2 possess it.
y’all shall observe 2 do therefore as tha LORD ur God has commanded u: y’all shall not turn aside 2 tha right hand or 2 tha left.
y’all shall walk in all tha ways which tha LORD ur God has commanded u, dat y’all may live, N dat it may be well wit u, N dat y’all may prolong ur days in tha land which y’all shall possess.

6.text: Now dese r tha commandments, tha statutes, N tha judgments, which tha LORD ur God commanded 2 teach u, dat y’all might do ’em in tha land where y’all go 2 possess it:
Dat u might fear tha LORD ur God, 2 keep all his statutes N his commandments, which I command u, u, N ur son, N ur son’s son, all tha days of ur life; N dat ur days may be prolonged.
Hear therefore, O Israel, N observe 2 do it; dat it may be well wit u, N dat y’all may increase mightily, as tha LORD God of ur fathers has promised u, in tha land dat flows wit milk N honey.
Hear, O Israel: tha LORD our God is one LORD:
N u will love tha LORD ur God wit all thine heart, N wit all ur soul, N wit all ur might.
N dese words, which I command u dis day, shall be in thine heart:
N u will teach ’em diligently 2 ur children, N will talk of ’em when u sit in thine house, N when u walk by tha way, N when u lie down, N when u rise up.
N u will bind ’em 4 a sign upon thine hand, N dey shall be as frontlets between ur eyes.
N u will write ’em upon tha posts of ur house, N on ur gates.
N it will be, when tha LORD ur God shall have brought u in2 tha land which he sware 2 ur fathers, 2 Abraham, 2 Isaac, N 2 Jacob, 2 give u great N goodly citiez, which u buildedst not,
N houses full of all good things, which u filledst not, N wells digged, which u diggedst not, vineyards N olive trees, which u plantedst not; when u will have eaten N be full;
Then beware lest u forget tha LORD, which brought u forth out of tha land of Egypt, from tha house of bondage.
u will fear tha LORD ur God, N serve him, N will swear by his name.
y’all shall not go after other gods, of tha gods of tha people which r round about u;
(4 tha LORD ur God is a jealous God among u) lest tha anger of tha LORD ur God be kindled against u, N destroy u from off tha face of tha earth.
y’all shall not tempt tha LORD ur God, as y’all tempted him in Massah.
y’all shall diligently keep tha commandments of tha LORD ur God, N his testimonies, N his statutes, which he has commanded u.
N u will do dat which is right N good in tha sight of tha LORD: dat it may be well wit u, N dat u may go in N possess tha good land which tha LORD sware 2 ur fathers,
2 cast out all thine opps from before u, as tha LORD has spoken.
N when ur son asks u in time 2 come, sayin, What mean tha testimonies, N tha statutes, N tha judgments, which tha LORD our God has commanded u?
Then u will say 2 ur son, We were Pharaoh’s bondmen in Egypt; N tha LORD brought us out of Egypt wit a mighty hand:
N tha LORD showed signs N wonders, great N sore, upon Egypt, upon Pharaoh, N upon all his household, before our eyes:
N he brought us out from thence, dat he might bring us in, 2 give us tha land which he sware 2 our fathers.
N tha LORD commanded us 2 do all dese statutes, 2 fear tha LORD our God, 4 our good always, dat he might preserve us alive, as it is at dis day.
N it will be our righteousness, if we observe 2 do all dese commandments before tha LORD our God, as he has commanded us.

7.text: When tha LORD ur God shall bring u in2 tha land where u go 2 possess it, N has cast out many nations before u, tha Hittites, N tha Girgashites, N tha Amorites, N tha Canaanites, N tha Perizzites, N tha Hivites, N tha Jebusites, seven nations greater N mightier than u;
N when tha LORD ur God shall deliver ’em before u; u will strike ’em, N utterly destroy ’em; u will make no covenant wit ’em, nor show mercy 2 ’em:
Neither will u make marriages wit ’em; ur daughter u will not give 2 his son, nor his daughter will u take 2 ur son.
4 dey will turn away ur son from followin me, dat dey may serve other gods: so will tha anger of tha LORD be kindled against u, N destroy u suddenly.
But like dis shall y’all deal wit ’em; y’all shall destroy their altars, N break down their images, N cut down their groves, N burn their graven images wit fire.
4 u r an holy people 2 tha LORD ur God: tha LORD ur God has chosen u 2 be a special people 2 himself, above all people dat r upon tha face of tha earth.
Tha LORD did not set his love upon u, nor choose u, because y’all were more in number than any people; 4 y’all were tha fewest of all people:

But because tha LORD loved u, N because he would keep tha oath which he had sworn 2 ur fathers, has tha LORD brought u out wit a mighty hand, N redeemed u out of tha house of bondmen, from tha hand of Pharaoh king of Egypt.
Know therefore dat tha LORD ur God, he is God, tha faithful God, which keeps covenant N mercy wit ’em dat love him N keep his commandments 2 a thousand generations;
N repayeth ’em dat hate him 2 their face, 2 destroy ’em: he will not be slack 2 him dat hates him, he will repay him 2 his face.
u will therefore keep tha commandments, N tha statutes, N tha judgments, which I command u dis day, 2 do ’em.
So it will happen, if y’all listen 2 dese judgments, N keep, N do ’em, dat tha LORD ur God shall keep 2 u tha covenant N tha mercy which he sware 2 ur fathers:

N he will love u, N bless u, N multiply u: he will also bless tha fruit of ur womb, N tha fruit of ur land, ur corn, N ur wine, N thine oil, tha increase of ur kine, N tha flocks of ur sheep, in tha land which he sware 2 ur fathers 2 give u.
u will be blessed above all people: there shall not be male or female barren among u, or among ur cattle.
N tha LORD will take away from u all sickness, N will put none of tha evil diseases of Egypt, which u know, upon u; but will lay ’em upon all ’em dat hate u.
N u will consume all tha people which tha LORD ur God shall deliver u; thine eye shall have no pity upon ’em: neither will u serve their gods; 4 dat will be a snare 2 u.
If u will say in thine heart, dese nations r more than I; how can I dispossess ’em?
u will not be afraid of ’em: but will well remember what tha LORD ur God did 2 Pharaoh, N 2 all Egypt;

Tha great temptations which ur eyes saw, N tha signs, N tha wonders, N tha mighty hand, N tha stretched out arm, whereby tha LORD ur God brought u out: so shall tha LORD ur God do 2 all tha people of whom u r afraid.
Moreover tha LORD ur God will send tha hornet among ’em, until dey dat r left, N hide themselves from u, be destroyed.
u will not be affrighted at ’em: 4 tha LORD ur God is among u, a mighty God N terrible.
N tha LORD ur God will put out dose nations before u by little N little: u may not consume ’em at once, lest tha beasts of tha field increase upon u.
But tha LORD ur God shall deliver ’em 2 u, N shall destroy ’em wit a mighty destruction, until dey be destroyed.
N he shall deliver their kings in2 thine hand, N u will destroy their name from under heaven: there shall no man be able 2 stand before u, until u have destroyed ’em.
Tha graven images of their gods shall y’all burn wit fire: u will not desire tha silver or gold dat is on ’em, nor take it 2 u, lest u be snared in it: 4 it is an abomination 2 tha LORD ur God.
Neither will u bring an abomination in2 thine house, lest u be a cursed thing like it: but u will utterly detest it, N u will utterly abhor it; 4 it is a cursed thing.

8.text: All tha commandments which I command u dis day shall y’all observe 2 do, dat y’all may live, N multiply, N go in N possess tha land which tha LORD sware 2 ur fathers.
N u will remember all tha way which tha LORD ur God led u dese forty years in tha wilderness, 2 humble u, N 2 prove u, 2 know what was in thine heart, whether u would keep his commandments, or no.

N he humbled u, N suffered u 2 hunger, N fed u wit manna, which u knew not, neither did ur fathers know; dat he might make u know dat man does not live by bread only, but by every word dat proceeds out of tha mouth of tha LORD does man live.
Ur clothing grew not old upon u, neither did ur foot swell, dese forty years.
u will also consider in thine heart, dat, as a man chasteneth his son, so tha LORD ur God chasteneth u.
Therefore u will keep tha commandments of tha LORD ur God, 2 walk in his ways, N 2 fear him.
4 tha LORD ur God brings u in2 a good land, a land of brooks of water, of fountains N depths dat spring out of valleys N hills;
A land of wheat, N barley, N vines, N fig trees, N pomegranates; a land of oil olive, N honey;
A land in which u will eat bread without scarceness, u will not lack any thing in it; a land whose stones r iron, N out of whose hills u may dig brass.
When u have eaten N art full, then u will bless tha LORD ur God 4 tha good land which he has given u.
Beware dat u forget not tha LORD ur God, in not keepin his commandments, N his judgments, N his statutes, which I command u dis day:
Lest when u have eaten N art full, N have built goodly houses, N lived in it;
N when ur herds N ur flocks multiply, N ur silver N ur gold is multiplied, N all dat u have is multiplied;
Then thine heart be lifted up, N u forget tha LORD ur God, which brought u forth out of tha land of Egypt, from tha house of bondage;
Who led u through dat great N terrible wilderness, in which were fiery serpents, N scorpions, N drought, where there was no water; who brought u forth water out of tha rock of flint;
Who fed u in tha wilderness wit manna, which ur fathers knew not, dat he might humble u, N dat he might prove u, 2 do u good at ur latter end;
N u say in thine heart, My power N tha might of mine hand has got me dis wealth.
But u will remember tha LORD ur God: 4 it is he dat gives u power 2 get wealth, dat he may establish his covenant which he sware 2 ur fathers, as it is dis day.
N it will be, if u do at all forget tha LORD ur God, N walk after other gods, N serve ’em, N worship ’em, I testify against u dis day dat y’all shall surely perish.
As tha nations which tha LORD destroys before ur face, so shall y’all perish; because y’all would not be obedient 2 tha voice of tha LORD ur God.

9.text: Hear, O Israel: u r 2 pass over Jordan dis day, 2 go in 2 possess nations greater N mightier than urself, citiez great N fenced up 2 heaven,
A people great N tall, tha children of tha Anakims, whom u know, N of whom u have heard say, Who can stand before tha children of Anak!

Understand therefore dis day, dat tha LORD ur God is he which goes over before u; as a consuming fire he shall destroy ’em, N he shall bring ’em down before ur face: so will u drive ’em out, N destroy ’em quickly, as tha LORD has said 2 u.

Speak not u in thine heart, after dat tha LORD ur God has cast ’em out from before u, sayin, 4 my righteousness tha LORD has brought me in 2 possess dis land: but 4 tha wickedness of dese nations tha LORD does drive ’em out from before u.

Not 4 ur righteousness, or 4 tha uprightness of thine heart, do u go 2 possess their land: but 4 tha wickedness of dese nations tha LORD ur God does drive ’em out from before u, N dat he may perform tha word which tha LORD sware 2 ur fathers, Abraham, Isaac, N Jacob.
Understand therefore, dat tha LORD ur God gives u not dis good land 2 possess it 4 ur righteousness; 4 u r a stiffnecked people.

Remember, N forget not, how u provokedst tha LORD ur God 2 wrath in tha wilderness: from tha day dat u did depart out of tha land of Egypt, until y’all came 2 dis place, y’all have been rebellious against tha LORD.
Also in Horeb y’all provoked tha LORD 2 wrath, so dat tha LORD was angry wit u 2 have destroyed u.

When I was gone up in2 tha mount 2 receive tha tables of stone, even tha tables of tha covenant which tha LORD made wit u, then I stayed in tha mount forty days N forty nights, I neither did eat bread nor drink water:

N tha LORD delivered 2 me two tables of stone written wit tha finger of God; N on ’em was written according 2 all tha words, which tha LORD spoke wit u in tha mount out of tha midst of tha fire in tha day of tha assembly.
N it happened at tha end of forty days N forty nights, dat tha LORD gave me tha two tables of stone, even tha tables of tha covenant.

N tha LORD said 2 me, Arise, get u down quickly from hence; 4 ur people which u have brought forth out of Egypt have corrupted themselves; dey r quickly turned aside out of tha way which I commanded ’em; dey have made ’em a molten image.
Furthermore tha LORD spoke 2 me, sayin, I have seen dis people, N, look, it is a stiffnecked people:
Let me alone, dat I may destroy ’em, N blot out their name from under heaven: N I will make of u a nation mightier N greater than dey.
So I turned N came down from tha mount, N tha mount burned wit fire: N tha two tables of tha covenant were in my two hands.
N I looked, N, look, y’all had sinned against tha LORD ur God, N had made u a molten calf: y’all had turned aside quickly out of tha way which tha LORD had commanded u.
N I took tha two tables, N cast ’em out of my two hands, N broke ’em before ur eyes.

N I fell down before tha LORD, as at tha first, forty days N forty nights: I did neither eat bread, nor drink water, because of all ur sins which y’all sinned, in doin wickedly in tha sight of tha LORD, 2 provoke him 2 anger.
4 I was afraid of tha anger N hot displeasure, wherewith tha LORD was angry against u 2 destroy u. But tha LORD listened 2 me at dat time also.
N tha LORD was very angry wit Aaron 2 have destroyed him: N I prayed 4 Aaron also tha same time.

N I took ur sin, tha calf which y’all had made, N burnt it wit fire, N stamped it, N ground it very small, even until it was as small as dust: N I cast tha dust of it in2 tha brook dat descended out of tha mount.
N at Taberah, N at Massah, N at Kibroth-hattaavah, y’all provoked tha LORD 2 wrath.

Likewise when tha LORD sent u from Kadesh-barnea, sayin, Go up N possess tha land which I have given u; then y’all rebelled against tha commandment of tha LORD ur God, N y’all believed him not, nor listened 2 his voice.
y’all have been rebellious against tha LORD from tha day dat I knew u.
Like dis I fell down before tha LORD forty days N forty nights, as I fell down at tha first; because tha LORD had said he would destroy u.
I prayed therefore 2 tha LORD, N said, O Lord GOD, destroy not ur people N thine inheritance, which u have redeemed through ur greatness, which u have brought forth out of Egypt wit a mighty hand.
Remember ur servants, Abraham, Isaac, N Jacob; look not 2 tha stubbornness of dis people, nor 2 their wickedness, nor 2 their sin:

Lest tha land from where u brought us out say, Because tha LORD was not able 2 bring ’em in2 tha land which he promised ’em, N because he hated ’em, he has brought ’em out 2 kill ’em in tha wilderness.
Yet dey r ur people N thine inheritance, which u brought out by ur mighty power N by ur stretched out arm.

10.text: At dat time tha LORD said 2 me, Hew u two tables of stone like 2 tha first, N come up 2 me in2 tha mount, N make u an ark of wood.
N I will write on tha tables tha words dat were in tha first tables which u brakest, N u will put ’em in tha ark.
N I made an ark of shittim wood, N hewed two tables of stone like 2 tha first, N went up in2 tha mount, havin tha two tables in mine hand.
N he wrote on tha tables, according 2 tha first writing, tha ten commandments, which tha LORD spoke 2 u in tha mount out of tha midst of tha fire in tha day of tha assembly: N tha LORD gave ’em 2 me.
N I turned myself N came down from tha mount, N put tha tables in tha ark which I had made; N there dey be, as tha LORD commanded me.
N tha children of Israel took their journey from Beeroth of tha children of Jaakan 2 Mosera: there Aaron died, N there he was buried; N Eleazar his son ministered in tha priest’s office in his stead.
From thence dey journeyed 2 Gudgodah; N from Gudgodah 2 Jotbath, a land of rivers of waterz.
At dat time tha LORD separated tha tribe of Levi, 2 bear tha ark of tha covenant of tha LORD, 2 stand before tha LORD 2 minister 2 him, N 2 bless in his name, 2 dis day.
So Levi has no part nor inheritance wit his brothers; tha LORD is his inheritance, according as tha LORD ur God promised him.
N I stayed in tha mount, according 2 tha first time, forty days N forty nights; N tha LORD listened 2 me at dat time also, N tha LORD would not destroy u.
N tha LORD said 2 me, Arise, take ur journey before tha people, dat dey may go in N possess tha land, which I sware 2 their fathers 2 give 2 ’em.
N now, Israel, what does tha LORD ur God require of u, but 2 fear tha LORD ur God, 2 walk in all his ways, N 2 love him, N 2 serve tha LORD ur God wit all ur heart N wit all ur soul,
2 keep tha commandments of tha LORD, N his statutes, which I command u dis day 4 ur good?
Look, tha heaven N tha heaven of heavenz is tha LORD’s ur God, tha earth also, wit all dat in it is.
Only tha LORD had a delight in ur fathers 2 love ’em, N he chose their seed after ’em, even u above all people, as it is dis day.
Circumcise therefore tha foreskin of ur heart, N be no more stiffnecked.
4 tha LORD ur God is God of gods, N Lord of lords, a great God, a mighty, N a terrible, which regards not persons, nor takes reward:
He does execute tha judgment of tha fatherless N widow, N loves tha stranger, in givin him food N clothing.
Love y’all therefore tha stranger: 4 y’all were strangers in tha land of Egypt.
u will fear tha LORD ur God; him will u serve, N 2 him will u cleave, N swear by his name.
He is ur praise, N he is ur God, dat has done 4 u dese great N terrible things, which ur eyes have seen.
Ur fathers went down in2 Egypt wit threescore N ten persons; N now tha LORD ur God has made u as tha stars of heaven 4 crowd.

11.text: Therefore u will love tha LORD ur God, N keep his charge, N his statutes, N his judgments, N his commandments, alway.
N know y’all dis day: 4 I speak not wit ur children which have not known, N which have not seen tha chastisement of tha LORD ur God, his greatness, his mighty hand, N his stretched out arm,
N his miracles, N his acts, which he did in tha midst of Egypt 2 Pharaoh tha king of Egypt, N 2 all his land;
N what he did 2 tha army of Egypt, 2 their horses, N 2 their chariots; how he made tha water of tha Red sea 2 overflow ’em as dey pursued after u, N how tha LORD has destroyed ’em 2 dis day;
N what he did 2 u in tha wilderness, until y’all came in2 dis place;

N what he did 2 Dathan N Abiram, tha sons of Eliab, tha son of Reuben: how tha earth opened her mouth, N swallowed ’em up, N their households, N their tents, N all tha substance dat was in their possession, in tha midst of all Israel:
But ur eyes have seen all tha great acts of tha LORD which he did.
Therefore shall y’all keep all tha commandments which I command u dis day, dat y’all may be strong, N go in N possess tha land, where y’all go 2 possess it;
N dat y’all may prolong ur days in tha land, which tha LORD sware 2 ur fathers 2 give 2 ’em N 2 their seed, a land dat flows wit milk N honey.
4 tha land, where u go in 2 possess it, is not as tha land of Egypt, from from where y’all came out, where u sowedst ur seed, N wateredst it wit ur foot, as a garden of herbs:
But tha land, where y’all go 2 possess it, is a land of hills N valleys, N drinks water of tha rain of heaven:
A land which tha LORD ur God cares 4: tha eyes of tha LORD ur God r always upon it, from tha beginning of tha year even 2 tha end of tha year.
N it will happen, if y’all shall listen diligently 2 my commandments which I command u dis day, 2 love tha LORD ur God, N 2 serve him wit all ur heart N wit all ur soul,
Dat I will give u tha rain of ur land in his due season, tha first rain N tha latter rain, dat u may gather in ur corn, N ur wine, N thine oil.
N I will send grass in ur fields 4 ur cattle, dat u may eat N be full.
Pay attention 2 y’all, dat ur heart don’t be deceived, N y’all turn aside, N serve other gods, N worship ’em;

N then tha LORD’s wrath be kindled against u, N he shut up tha heaven, dat there be no rain, N dat tha land yield not her fruit; N lest y’all perish quickly from off tha good land which tha LORD gives u.
Therefore shall y’all lay up dese my words in ur heart N in ur soul, N bind ’em 4 a sign upon ur hand, dat dey may be as frontlets between ur eyes.
N y’all shall teach ’em ur children, speakin of ’em when u sit in thine house, N when u walk by tha way, when u lie down, N when u rise up.
N u will write ’em upon tha door posts of thine house, N upon ur gates:
Dat ur days may be multiplied, N tha days of ur children, in tha land which tha LORD sware 2 ur fathers 2 give ’em, as tha days of heaven upon tha earth.
4 if y’all shall diligently keep all dese commandments which I command u, 2 do ’em, 2 love tha LORD ur God, 2 walk in all his ways, N 2 cleave 2 him;
Then will tha LORD drive out all dese nations from before u, N y’all shall possess greater nations N mightier than y’all.
Every place whereon tha soles of ur feet shall tread shall be urz: from tha wilderness N Lebanon, from tha river, tha river Euphrates, even 2 tha uttermost sea shall ur coast be.
There shall no man be able 2 stand before u: 4 tha LORD ur God shall lay tha fear of u N tha dread of u upon all tha land dat y’all shall tread upon, as he has said 2 u.
Look, I set before u dis day a blessing N a curse;
A blessing, if y’all obey tha commandments of tha LORD ur God, which I command u dis day:
N a curse, if y’all will not obey tha commandments of tha LORD ur God, but turn aside out of tha way which I command u dis day, 2 go after other gods, which y’all have not known.
N it will happen, when tha LORD ur God has brought u in 2 tha land where u go 2 possess it, dat u will put tha blessing upon mount Gerizim, N tha curse upon mount Ebal.
R dey not on tha other side Jordan, by tha way where tha sun goes down, in tha land of tha Canaanites, which live in tha champaign over against Gilgal, beside tha plains of Moreh?
4 y’all shall pass over Jordan 2 go in 2 possess tha land which tha LORD ur God gives u, N y’all shall possess it, N live in it.
N y’all shall observe 2 do all tha statutes N judgments which I set before u dis day.

12.text: Dese r tha statutes N judgments, which y’all shall observe 2 do in tha land, which tha LORD God of ur fathers gives u 2 possess it, all tha days dat y’all live upon tha earth.
y’all shall utterly destroy all tha places, in which tha nations which y’all shall possess served their gods, upon tha high mountains, N upon tha hills, N under every green tree:
N y’all shall overthrow their altars, N break their pillars, N burn their groves wit fire; N y’all shall hew down tha graven images of their gods, N destroy tha namez of ’em out of dat place.
y’all shall not do so 2 tha LORD ur God.
But 2 tha place which tha LORD ur God shall choose out of all ur tribes 2 put his name there, even 2 his habitation shall y’all seek, N there u will come:
N there y’all shall bring ur burnt offerings, N ur sacrifices, N ur tithes, N heave offerings of ur hand, N ur vows, N ur freewill offerings, N tha firstlings of ur herds N of ur flocks:
N there y’all shall eat before tha LORD ur God, N y’all shall rejoice in all dat y’all put ur hand 2, y’all N ur households, in which tha LORD ur God has blessed u.
y’all shall not do after all tha things dat we do here dis day, every man whatever is right in his own eyes.
4 y’all r not as yet come 2 tha rest N 2 tha inheritance, which tha LORD ur God gives u.
But when y’all go over Jordan, N live in tha land which tha LORD ur God gives u 2 inherit, N when he gives u rest from all ur opps round about, so dat y’all live in safety;

Then there shall be a place which tha LORD ur God shall choose 2 cause his name 2 live there; there shall y’all bring all dat I command u; ur burnt offerings, N ur sacrifices, ur tithes, N tha heave offering of ur hand, N all ur choice vows which y’all vow 2 tha LORD:

N y’all shall rejoice before tha LORD ur God, y’all, N ur sons, N ur daughters, N ur menservants, N ur maidservants, N tha Levite dat is within ur gates; forasmuch as he has no part nor inheritance wit u.
Pay attention 2 urself dat u offer not ur burnt offerings in every place dat u see:
But in tha place which tha LORD shall choose in one of ur tribes, there u will offer ur burnt offerings, N there u will do all dat I command u.

Even so u may kill N eat flesh in all ur gates, whatever ur soul lusteth after, according 2 tha blessing of tha LORD ur God which he has given u: tha unclean N tha clean may eat of it, as of tha roebuck, N as of tha hart.
Only y’all shall not eat tha blood; y’all shall pour it upon tha earth as water.

u may not eat within ur gates tha tithe of ur corn, or of ur wine, or of ur oil, or tha firstlings of ur herds or of ur flock, nor any of ur vows which u vowest, nor ur freewill offerings, or heave offering of thine hand:

But u must eat ’em before tha LORD ur God in tha place which tha LORD ur God shall choose, u, N ur son, N ur daughter, N ur manservant, N ur maidservant, N tha Levite dat is within ur gates: N u will rejoice before tha LORD ur God in all dat u put thine hands 2.
Pay attention 2 urself dat u forsake not tha Levite as long as u live upon tha earth.
When tha LORD ur God shall enlarge ur border, as he has promised u, N u will say, I will eat flesh, because ur soul longeth 2 eat flesh; u may eat flesh, whatever ur soul lusteth after.

If tha place which tha LORD ur God has chosen 2 put his name there be too far from u, then u will kill of ur herd N of ur flock, which tha LORD has given u, as I have commanded u, N u will eat in ur gates whatever ur soul lusteth after.
Even as tha roebuck N tha hart is eaten, so u will eat ’em: tha unclean N tha clean shall eat of ’em alike.
Only be sure dat u eat not tha blood: 4 tha blood is tha life; N u may not eat tha life wit tha flesh.
u will not eat it; u will pour it upon tha earth as water.
u will not eat it; dat it may go well wit u, N wit ur children after u, when u will do dat which is right in tha sight of tha LORD.
Only ur holy things which u have, N ur vows, u will take, N go 2 tha place which tha LORD shall choose:

N u will offer ur burnt offerings, tha flesh N tha blood, upon tha altar of tha LORD ur God: N tha blood of ur sacrifices shall be poured out upon tha altar of tha LORD ur God, N u will eat tha flesh.
Observe N hear all dese words which I command u, dat it may go well wit u, N wit ur children after u 4 ever, when u do dat which is good N right in tha sight of tha LORD ur God.
When tha LORD ur God shall cut off tha nations from before u, where u go 2 possess ’em, N u succeedest ’em, N dwell in their land;

Pay attention 2 urself dat u don’t be snared by followin ’em, after dat dey be destroyed from before u; N dat u enquire not after their gods, sayin, How did dese nations serve their gods? even so will I do likewise.
u will not do so 2 tha LORD ur God: 4 every abomination 2 tha LORD, which he hates, have dey done 2 their gods; 4 even their sons N their daughters dey have burnt in tha fire 2 their gods.
What thing soever I command u, observe 2 do it: u will not add thereto, nor diminish from it.

13.text: If there arise among u a prophet, or a dreamer of dreams, N gives u a sign or a wonder,
N tha sign or tha wonder come 2 pass, whereof he spoke 2 u, sayin, Let us go after other gods, which u have not known, N let us serve ’em;
u will not listen 2 tha words of dat prophet, or dat dreamer of dreams: 4 tha LORD ur God proveth u, 2 know whether y’all love tha LORD ur God wit all ur heart N wit all ur soul.
y’all shall walk after tha LORD ur God, N fear him, N keep his commandments, N obey his voice, N y’all shall serve him, N cleave 2 him.

N dat prophet, or dat dreamer of dreams, shall be put 2 death; because he has spoken 2 turn u away from tha LORD ur God, which brought u out of tha land of Egypt, N redeemed u out of tha house of bondage, 2 thrust u out of tha way which tha LORD ur God commanded u 2 walk in. So will u put tha evil away from tha midst of u.

If ur brother, tha son of ur mother, or ur son, or ur daughter, or tha wife of ur bosom, or ur friend, which is as ur own soul, entice u secretly, sayin, Let us go N serve other gods, which u have not known, u, nor ur fathers;
Namely, of tha gods of tha people which r round about u, nigh 2 u, or far off from u, from tha one end of tha earth even 2 tha other end of tha earth;
u will not consent 2 him, nor listen 2 him; neither shall thine eye pity him, neither will u spare, neither will u conceal him:
But u will surely kill him; thine hand shall be first upon him 2 put him 2 death, N afterwards tha hand of all tha people.
N u will stone him wit stones, dat he die; because he has sought 2 thrust u away from tha LORD ur God, which brought u out of tha land of Egypt, from tha house of bondage.
N all Israel shall hear, N fear, N shall do no more any such wickedness as dis is among u.
If u will hear say in one of ur citiez, which tha LORD ur God has given u 2 live there, sayin,
Certain men, tha children of Belial, r gone out from among u, N have withdrawn tha inhabitants of their city, sayin, Let us go N serve other gods, which y’all have not known;
Then will u enquire, N make search, N ask diligently; N, look, if it be truth, N tha thing certain, dat such abomination is wrought among u;
u will surely strike tha inhabitants of dat city wit tha edge of tha sword, destroying it utterly, N all dat is in it, N tha cattle of it, wit tha edge of tha sword.

N u will gather all tha spoil of it in2 tha midst of tha street of it, N will burn wit fire tha city, N all tha spoil of it every whit, 4 tha LORD ur God: N it will be an heap 4 ever; it shall not be built again.

N there shall cleave nothing of tha cursed thing 2 thine hand: dat tha LORD may turn from tha fierceness of his anger, N show u mercy, N have compassion upon u, N multiply u, as he has sworn 2 ur fathers;
When u will listen 2 tha voice of tha LORD ur God, 2 keep all his commandments which I command u dis day, 2 do dat which is right in tha eyes of tha LORD ur God.

14.text: y’all r tha children of tha LORD ur God: y’all shall not cut y’all, nor make any baldness between ur eyes 4 tha dead.
4 u r an holy people 2 tha LORD ur God, N tha LORD has chosen u 2 be a peculiar people 2 himself, above all tha nations dat r upon tha earth.
u will not eat any abominable thing.
Dese r tha beasts which y’all shall eat: tha ox, tha sheep, N tha goat,
Tha hart, N tha roebuck, N tha fallow deer, N tha wild goat, N tha pygarg, N tha wild ox, N tha chamois.
N every beast dat parteth tha hoof, N clings tha cleft in2 two claws, N chews tha cud among tha beasts, dat y’all shall eat.

Nevertheless dese y’all shall not eat of ’em dat chew tha cud, or of ’em dat divide tha cloven hoof; as tha camel, N tha hare, N tha coney: 4 dey chew tha cud, but divide not tha hoof; therefore dey r unclean 2 u.
N tha swine, because it divides tha hoof, yet chews not tha cud, it is unclean 2 u: y’all shall not eat of their flesh, nor touch their dead carcase.
Dese y’all shall eat of all dat r in tha waterz: all dat have fins N scales shall y’all eat:
N whatever has not fins N scales y’all may not eat; it is unclean 2 u.
Of all clean birds y’all shall eat.
But dese r dey of which y’all shall not eat: tha eagle, N tha ossifrage, N tha ospray,
N tha glede, N tha kite, N tha vulture after his kind,
N every raven after his kind,
N tha owl, N tha night hawk, N tha cuckow, N tha hawk after his kind,
Tha little owl, N tha great owl, N tha swan,
N tha pelican, N tha gier eagle, N tha cormorant,
N tha stork, N tha heron after her kind, N tha lapwing, N tha bat.
N every creeping thing dat flieth is unclean 2 u: dey shall not be eaten.
But of all clean fowls y’all may eat.

y’all shall not eat of any thing dat dies of itself: u will give it 2 tha stranger dat is in ur gates, dat he may eat it; or u may sell it 2 an alien: 4 u r an holy people 2 tha LORD ur God. u will not seethe a kid in his mother’s milk.
u will truly tithe all tha increase of ur seed, dat tha field brings forth year by year.

N u will eat before tha LORD ur God, in tha place which he shall choose 2 place his name there, tha tithe of ur corn, of ur wine, N of thine oil, N tha firstlings of ur herds N of ur flocks; dat u may learn 2 fear tha LORD ur God always.
N if tha way be too long 4 u, so dat u r not able 2 carry it; or if tha place be too far from u, which tha LORD ur God shall choose 2 set his name there, when tha LORD ur God has blessed u:
Then will u turn it in2 money, N bind up tha money in thine hand, N will go 2 tha place which tha LORD ur God shall choose:

N u will bestow dat money 4 whatever ur soul lusteth after, 4 oxen, or 4 sheep, or 4 wine, or 4 strong drink, or 4 whatever ur soul desires: N u will eat there before tha LORD ur God, N u will rejoice, u, N thine household,
N tha Levite dat is within ur gates; u will not forsake him; 4 he has no part nor inheritance wit u.
At tha end of three years u will bring forth all tha tithe of thine increase tha same year, N will lay it up within ur gates:

N tha Levite, (because he has no part nor inheritance wit u,) N tha stranger, N tha fatherless, N tha widow, which r within ur gates, shall come, N shall eat N be satisfied; dat tha LORD ur God may bless u in all tha work of thine hand which u do.

15.text: At tha end of every seven years u will make a release.

N dis is tha manner of tha release: Every creditor dat lendeth ought 2 his neighbour shall release it; he shall not exact it of his neighbour, or of his brother; because it is called tha LORD’s release.
Of a foreigner u may exact it again: but dat which is thine wit ur brother thine hand shall release;
Save when there shall be no poor among u; 4 tha LORD shall greatly bless u in tha land which tha LORD ur God gives u 4 an inheritance 2 possess it:
Only if u carefully listen 2 tha voice of tha LORD ur God, 2 observe 2 do all dese commandments which I command u dis day.
4 tha LORD ur God blesses u, as he promised u: N u will lend 2 many nations, but u will not borrow; N u will reign over many nations, but dey shall not reign over u.
If there be among u a poor man of one of ur brothers within any of ur gates in ur land which tha LORD ur God gives u, u will not harden thine heart, nor shut thine hand from ur poor brother:
But u will open thine hand wide 2 him, N will surely lend him sufficient 4 his need, in dat which he wants.

Beware dat there don’t be a thought in ur wicked heart, sayin, tha seventh year, tha year of release, is at hand; N thine eye be evil against ur poor brother, N u give him nothing; N he cry 2 tha LORD against u, N it be sin 2 u.
u will surely give him, N thine heart shall not be grieved when u give 2 him: because dat 4 dis thing tha LORD ur God shall bless u in all ur works, N in all dat u put thine hand 2.
4 tha poor shall never cease out of tha land: therefore I command u, sayin, u will open thine hand wide 2 ur brother, 2 ur poor, N 2 ur needy, in ur land.
N if ur brother, an Hebrew man, or an Hebrew woman, be sold 2 u, N serve u six years; then in tha seventh year u will let him go free from u.
N when u send him out free from u, u will not let him go away empty:
u will furnish him liberally out of ur flock, N out of ur floor, N out of ur winepress: of dat wherewith tha LORD ur God has blessed u u will give 2 him.
N u will remember dat u were a bondman in tha land of Egypt, N tha LORD ur God redeemed u: therefore I command u dis thing 2 day.
N it will be, if he say 2 u, I will not go away from u; because he loves u N thine house, because he is well wit u;
Then u will take an aul, N thrust it through his ear 2 tha door, N he shall be ur servant 4 ever. N also 2 ur maidservant u will do likewise.
It shall not seem hard 2 u, when u send him away free from u; 4 he has been worth a double hired servant 2 u, in servin u six years: N tha LORD ur God shall bless u in all dat u do.
All tha firstling males dat come of ur herd N of ur flock u will sanctify 2 tha LORD ur God: u will do no work wit tha firstling of ur bullock, nor shear tha firstling of ur sheep.
u will eat it before tha LORD ur God year by year in tha place which tha LORD shall choose, u N ur household.
N if there be any blemish in it, as if it be lame, or blind, or have any ill blemish, u will not sacrifice it 2 tha LORD ur God.
u will eat it within ur gates: tha unclean N tha clean person shall eat it alike, as tha roebuck, N as tha hart.
Only u will not eat tha blood of it; u will pour it upon tha ground as water.

16.text: Observe tha month of Abib, N keep tha passover 2 tha LORD ur God: 4 in tha month of Abib tha LORD ur God brought u forth out of Egypt by night.
u will therefore sacrifice tha passover 2 tha LORD ur God, of tha flock N tha herd, in tha place which tha LORD shall choose 2 place his name there.

u will eat no leavened bread wit it; seven days will u eat unleavened bread wit it, even tha bread of affliction; 4 u came forth out of tha land of Egypt in haste: dat u may remember tha day when u came forth out of tha land of Egypt all tha days of ur life.
N there shall be no leavened bread seen wit u in all ur coast seven days; neither shall there any thing of tha flesh, which u sacrificedst tha first day at even, remain all night until tha morning.
u may not sacrifice tha passover within any of ur gates, which tha LORD ur God gives u:
But at tha place which tha LORD ur God shall choose 2 place his name in, there u will sacrifice tha passover at even, at tha goin down of tha sun, at tha season dat u came forth out of Egypt.
N u will roast N eat it in tha place which tha LORD ur God shall choose: N u will turn in tha morning, N go 2 ur tents.
Six days u will eat unleavened bread: N on tha seventh day shall be a solemn assembly 2 tha LORD ur God: u will do no work in it.
Seven weeks will u number 2 u: begin 2 number tha seven weeks from such time as u beginnest 2 put tha sickle 2 tha corn.
N u will keep tha feast of weeks 2 tha LORD ur God wit a tribute of a freewill offering of thine hand, which u will give 2 tha Lord ur God, according as tha LORD ur God has blessed u:

N u will rejoice before tha LORD ur God, u, N ur son, N ur daughter, N ur manservant, N ur maidservant, N tha Levite dat is within ur gates, N tha stranger, N tha fatherless, N tha widow, dat r among u, in tha place which tha LORD ur God has chosen 2 place his name there.
N u will remember dat u were a bondman in Egypt: N u will observe N do dese statutes.
u will observe tha feast of tabernacles seven days, after dat u have gathered in ur corn N ur wine:
N u will rejoice in ur feast, u, N ur son, N ur daughter, N ur manservant, N ur maidservant, N tha Levite, tha stranger, N tha fatherless, N tha widow, dat r within ur gates.

Seven days will u keep a solemn feast 2 tha LORD ur God in tha place which tha LORD shall choose: because tha LORD ur God shall bless u in all thine increase, N in all tha works of thine hands, therefore u will surely rejoice.

Three times in a year shall all ur males appear before tha LORD ur God in tha place which he shall choose; in tha feast of unleavened bread, N in tha feast of weeks, N in tha feast of tabernacles: N dey shall not appear before tha LORD empty:
Every man shall give as he is able, according 2 tha blessing of tha LORD ur God which he has given u.
Judges N officers will u make u in all ur gates, which tha LORD ur God gives u, throughout ur tribes: N dey shall judge tha people wit just judgment.
u will not wrest judgment; u will not respect persons, neither take a gift: 4 a gift does blind tha eyes of tha wise, N pervert tha words of tha righteous.
Dat which is altogether just will u follow, dat u may live, N inherit tha land which tha LORD ur God gives u.
u will not plant u a grove of any trees near 2 tha altar of tha LORD ur God, which u will make u.
Neither will u set u up any image; which tha LORD ur God hates.

17.text: u will not sacrifice 2 tha LORD ur God any bullock, or sheep, in which is blemish, or any evilfavouredness: 4 dat is an abomination 2 tha LORD ur God.
If there be found among u, within any of ur gates which tha LORD ur God gives u, man or woman, dat has wrought wickedness in tha sight of tha LORD ur God, in transgressing his covenant,
N has gone N served other gods, N worshipped ’em, either tha sun, or moon, or any of tha host of heaven, which I have not commanded;
N it be told u, N u have heard of it, N enquired diligently, N, look, it be true, N tha thing certain, dat such abomination is wrought in Israel:
Then will u bring forth dat man or dat woman, which have committed dat wicked thing, 2 ur gates, even dat man or dat woman, N will stone ’em wit stones, till dey die.
At tha mouth of two witnesses, or three witnesses, shall he dat is worthy of death be put 2 death; but at tha mouth of one witness he shall not be put 2 death.
Tha hands of tha witnesses shall be first upon him 2 put him 2 death, N afterward tha hands of all tha people. So u will put tha evil away from among u.

If there arise a matter too hard 4 u in judgment, between blood N blood, between plea N plea, N between stroke N stroke, bein matters of controversy within ur gates: then will u arise, N get u up in2 tha place which tha LORD ur God shall choose;
N u will come 2 tha priests tha Levites, N 2 tha judge dat shall be in dose days, N enquire; N dey shall show u tha sentence of judgment:
N u will do according 2 tha sentence, which dey of dat place which tha LORD shall choose shall show u; N u will observe 2 do according 2 all dat dey inform u:

According 2 tha sentence of tha law which dey shall teach u, N according 2 tha judgment which dey shall tell u, u will do: u will not decline from tha sentence which dey shall show u, 2 tha right hand, nor 2 tha left.

N tha man dat will do presumptuously, N will not listen 2 tha priest dat stands 2 minister there before tha LORD ur God, or 2 tha judge, even dat man shall die: N u will put away tha evil from Israel.
N all tha people shall hear, N fear, N do no more presumptuously.
When u r come 2 tha land which tha LORD ur God gives u, N will possess it, N will live in it, N will say, I will set a king over me, like as all tha nations dat r about me;
u will in any wise set him king over u, whom tha LORD ur God shall choose: one from among ur brothers will u set king over u: u may not set a stranger over u, which is not ur brother.

But he shall not multiply horses 2 himself, nor cause tha people 2 return 2 Egypt, 2 tha end dat he should multiply horses: forasmuch as tha LORD has said 2 u, y’all shall from now on return no more dat way.
Neither shall he multiply wives 2 himself, dat his heart turn not away: neither shall he greatly multiply 2 himself silver N gold.
N it will be, when he sits upon tha throne of his kingdom, dat he shall write him a copy of dis law in a book out of dat which is before tha priests tha Levites:
N it will be wit him, N he shall read in it all tha days of his life: dat he may learn 2 fear tha LORD his God, 2 keep all tha words of dis law N dese statutes, 2 do ’em:

Dat his heart don’t be lifted up above his brothers, N dat he turn not aside from tha commandment, 2 tha right hand, or 2 tha left: 2 tha end dat he may prolong his days in his kingdom, he, N his children, in tha midst of Israel.

18.text: Tha priests tha Levites, N all tha tribe of Levi, shall have no part nor inheritance wit Israel: dey shall eat tha offerings of tha LORD made by fire, N his inheritance.
Therefore shall dey have no inheritance among their brothers: tha LORD is their inheritance, as he has said 2 ’em.
N dis shall be tha priest’s due from tha people, from ’em dat offer a sacrifice, whether it be ox or sheep; N dey shall give 2 tha priest tha shoulder, N tha two cheeks, N tha maw.
Tha firstfruit also of ur corn, of ur wine, N of thine oil, N tha first of tha fleece of ur sheep, will u give him.
4 tha LORD ur God has chosen him out of all ur tribes, 2 stand 2 minister in tha name of tha LORD, him N his sons 4 ever.
N if a Levite come from any of ur gates out of all Israel, where he stayed, N come wit all tha desire of his mind 2 tha place which tha LORD shall choose;
Then he shall minister in tha name of tha LORD his God, as all his brothers tha Levites do, which stand there before tha LORD.
Dey shall have like portions 2 eat, beside dat which comes of tha sale of his patrimony.
When u r come in2 tha land which tha LORD ur God gives u, u will not learn 2 do after tha abominations of dose nations.
There shall not be found among u any one dat makes his son or his daughter 2 pass through tha fire, or dat uses divination, or an observer of times, or an enchanter, or a witch,
Or a charmer, or a consulter wit familiar spirits, or a wizard, or a necromancer.
4 all dat do dese things r an abomination 2 tha LORD: N because of dese abominations tha LORD ur God does drive ’em out from before u.
u will be perfect wit tha LORD ur God.
4 dese nations, which u will possess, listened 2 observers of times, N 2 diviners: but as 4 u, tha LORD ur God has not suffered u so 2 do.
Tha LORD ur God will raise up 2 u a Prophet from tha midst of u, of ur brothers, like 2 me; 2 him y’all shall listen;

According 2 all dat u desiredst of tha LORD ur God in Horeb in tha day of tha assembly, sayin, Let me not hear again tha voice of tha LORD my God, neither let me see dis great fire any more, dat I die not.
N tha LORD said 2 me, dey have well spoken dat which dey have spoken.
I will raise ’em up a Prophet from among their brothers, like 2 u, N will put my words in his mouth; N he shall speak 2 ’em all dat I shall command him.
N it will happen, dat whoever will not listen 2 my words which he shall speak in my name, I will require it of him.
But tha prophet, which shall presume 2 speak a word in my name, which I have not commanded him 2 speak, or dat shall speak in tha name of other gods, even dat prophet shall die.
N if u say in thine heart, How shall we know tha word which tha LORD has not spoken?

When a prophet speaks in tha name of tha LORD, if tha thing follow not, nor come 2 pass, dat is tha thing which tha LORD has not spoken, but tha prophet has spoken it presumptuously: u will not be afraid of him.

19.text: When tha LORD ur God has cut off tha nations, whose land tha LORD ur God gives u, N u succeedest ’em, N dwell in their citiez, N in their houses;
u will separate three citiez 4 u in tha midst of ur land, which tha LORD ur God gives u 2 possess it.
u will prepare u a way, N divide tha coasts of ur land, which tha LORD ur God gives u 2 inherit, in2 three parts, dat every slayer may flee there.
N dis is tha case of tha slayer, which shall flee there, dat he may live: whoever kills his neighbour ignorantly, whom he hated not in time past;

As when a man goes in2 tha wood wit his neighbour 2 hew wood, N his hand fetcheth a stroke wit tha axe 2 cut down tha tree, N tha head slippeth from tha helve, N lighteth upon his neighbour, dat he die; he shall flee 2 one of dose citiez, N live:

Lest tha avenger of tha blood pursue tha slayer, while his heart is hot, N overtake him, because tha way is long, N kill him; whereas he was not worthy of death, since as he hated him not in time past.
So I command u, sayin, u will separate three citiez 4 u.
N if tha LORD ur God enlarge ur coast, as he has sworn 2 ur fathers, N give u all tha land which he promised 2 give 2 ur fathers;
If u will keep all dese commandments 2 do ’em, which I command u dis day, 2 love tha LORD ur God, N 2 walk ever in his ways; then will u add three citiez more 4 u, beside dese three:
Dat innocent blood don’t be shed in ur land, which tha LORD ur God gives u 4 an inheritance, N so blood be upon u.
But if any man hate his neighbour, N lie in wait 4 him, N rise up against him, N strike him mortally dat he die, N flees in2 one of dese citiez:
Then tha elders of his city shall send N fetch him thence, N deliver him in2 tha hand of tha avenger of blood, dat he may die.
Thine eye shall not pity him, but u will put away tha guilt of innocent blood from Israel, dat it may go well wit u.
u will not remove ur neighbour’s landmark, which dey of old time have set in thine inheritance, which u will inherit in tha land dat tha LORD ur God gives u 2 possess it.
One witness shall not rise up against a man 4 any iniquity, or 4 any sin, in any sin dat he sins: at tha mouth of two witnesses, or at tha mouth of three witnesses, shall tha matter be established.
If a false witness rise up against any man 2 testify against him dat which is wrong;
Then both tha men, between whom tha controversy is, shall stand before tha LORD, before tha priests N tha judges, which shall be in dose days;
N tha judges shall make diligent inquisition: N, look, if tha witness be a false witness, N has testified falsely against his brother;
Then shall y’all do 2 him, as he had thought 2 have done 2 his brother: so will u put tha evil away from among u.
N dose which remain shall hear, N fear, N shall from now on commit no more any such evil among u.
N thine eye shall not pity; but life shall go 4 life, eye 4 eye, tooth 4 tooth, hand 4 hand, foot 4 foot.

20.text: When u go out 2 battle against thine opps, N see horses, N chariots, N a people more than u, don’t be afraid of ’em: 4 tha LORD ur God is wit u, which brought u up out of tha land of Egypt.
N it will be, when y’all r come nigh 2 tha battle, dat tha priest shall approach N speak 2 tha people,
N shall say 2 ’em, Hear, O Israel, y’all approach dis day 2 battle against ur opps: don’t let ur hearts faint, don’t fear, N do not tremble, neither be y’all terrified because of ’em;
4 tha LORD ur God is he dat goes wit u, 2 fight 4 u against ur opps, 2 save u.

N tha officers shall speak 2 tha people, sayin, What man is there dat has built a new house, N has not dedicated it? let him go N return 2 his house, lest he die in tha battle, N another man dedicate it.
N what man is he dat has planted a vineyard, N has not yet eaten of it? let him also go N return 2 his house, lest he die in tha battle, N another man eat of it.
N what man is there dat has betrothed a wife, N has not taken her? let him go N return 2 his house, lest he die in tha battle, N another man take her.

N tha officers shall speak further 2 tha people, N dey shall say, What man is there dat is fearful N fainthearted? let him go N return 2 his house, lest his brothers’ heart faint as well as his heart.
N it will be, when tha officers have made an end of speakin 2 tha people, dat dey shall make captains of tha armies 2 lead tha people.
When u come nigh 2 a city 2 fight against it, then proclaim peace 2 it.
N it will be, if it make u answer of peace, N open 2 u, then it shall be, dat all tha people dat is found in it shall be tributaries 2 u, N dey shall serve u.
N if it will make no peace wit u, but will make war against u, then u will besiege it:
N when tha LORD ur God has delivered it in2 thine hands, u will strike every male of it wit tha edge of tha sword:
But tha women, N tha little ones, N tha cattle, N all dat is in tha city, even all tha spoil of it, will u take 2 urself; N u will eat tha spoil of thine opps, which tha LORD ur God has given u.
Like dis will u do 2 all tha citiez which r very far off from u, which r not of tha citiez of dese nations.
But of tha citiez of dese people, which tha LORD ur God does give u 4 an inheritance, u will save alive nothing dat breatheth:
But u will utterly destroy ’em; namely, tha Hittites, N tha Amorites, tha Canaanites, N tha Perizzites, tha Hivites, N tha Jebusites; as tha LORD ur God has commanded u:
Dat dey teach u not 2 do after all their abominations, which dey have done 2 their gods; so should y’all sin against tha LORD ur God.

When u will besiege a city a long time, in makin war against it 2 take it, u will not destroy tha trees of it by forcing an axe against ’em: 4 u may eat of ’em, N u will not cut ’em down (4 tha tree of tha field is man’s life ) 2 employ ’em in tha siege:
Only tha trees which u know dat dey don’t be trees 4 food, u will destroy N cut ’em down; N u will build bulwarks against tha city dat makes war wit u, until it be subdued.

21.text: If one be found killed in tha land which tha LORD ur God gives u 2 possess it, lyin in tha field, N it don’t be known who has killed him:
Then ur elders N ur judges shall come forth, N dey shall measure 2 tha citiez which r round about him dat is killed:
N it will be, dat tha city which is next 2 tha killed man, even tha elders of dat city shall take an heifer, which has not been wrought wit, N which has not drawn in tha yoke;
N tha elders of dat city shall bring down tha heifer 2 a rough valley, which is neither eared nor sown, N shall strike off tha heifer’s neck there in tha valley:
N tha priests tha sons of Levi shall come near; 4 ’em tha LORD ur God has chosen 2 minister 2 him, N 2 bless in tha name of tha LORD; N by their word shall every controversy N every stroke be tried:
N all tha elders of dat city, dat r next 2 tha killed man, shall wash their hands over tha heifer dat is beheaded in tha valley:
N dey shall answer N say, Our hands have not shed dis blood, neither have our eyes seen it.
Be merciful, O LORD, 2 ur people Israel, whom u have redeemed, N lay not innocent blood 2 ur people of Israel’s charge. N tha blood shall be forgiven ’em.
So will u put away tha guilt of innocent blood from among u, when u will do dat which is right in tha sight of tha LORD.
When u go forth 2 war against thine opps, N tha LORD ur God has delivered ’em in2 thine hands, N u have taken ’em captive,
N see among tha captives a beautiful woman, N have a desire 2 her, dat u would have her 2 ur wife;
Then u will bring her home 2 thine house; N she shall shave her head, N pare her nails;
