N she shall put tha clothing of her captivity from off her, N shall remain in thine house, N bewail her father N her mother a full month: N after dat u will go in 2 her, N be her husband, N she shall be ur wife.
N it will be, if u have no delight in her, then u will let her go where she will; but u will not sell her at all 4 money, u will not make merchandise of her, because u have humbled her.
If a man have two wives, one beloved, N another hated, N dey have born him children, both tha beloved N tha hated; N if tha firstborn son be hers dat was hated:
Then it shall be, when he makes his sons 2 inherit dat which he has, dat he may not make tha son of tha beloved firstborn before tha son of tha hated, which is indeed tha firstborn:
But he shall acknowledge tha son of tha hated 4 tha firstborn, by givin him a double portion of all dat he has: 4 he is tha beginning of his strength; tha right of tha firstborn is his.
If a man have a stubborn N rebellious son, which will not obey tha voice of his father, or tha voice of his mother, N dat, when dey have chastened him, will not listen 2 ’em:
Then shall his father N his mother lay hold on him, N bring him out 2 tha elders of his city, N 2 tha gate of his place;
N dey shall say 2 tha elders of his city, dis our son is stubborn N rebellious, he will not obey our voice; he is a glutton, N a drunkard.
N all tha men of his city shall stone him wit stones, dat he die: so will u put evil away from among u; N all Israel shall hear, N fear.
N if a man have committed a sin worthy of death, N he be 2 be put 2 death, N u hang him on a tree:

His body shall not remain all night upon tha tree, but u will in any wise bury him dat day; (4 he dat is hanged is accursed of God;) dat ur land don’t be defiled, which tha LORD ur God gives u 4 an inheritance.

22.text: u will not see ur brother’s ox or his sheep go astray, N hide urself from ’em: u will in any case bring ’em again 2 ur brother.
N if ur brother don’t be nigh 2 u, or if u know him not, then u will bring it 2 ur own house, N it will be wit u until ur brother seek after it, N u will restore it 2 him again.
In like manner will u do wit his ass; N so will u do wit his clothing; N wit all lost thing of ur brother’s, which he has lost, N u have found, will u do likewise: u may not hide urself.
u will not see ur brother’s ass or his ox fall down by tha way, N hide urself from ’em: u will surely help him 2 lift ’em up again.
Tha woman shall not wear dat which pertains 2 a man, neither shall a man put on a woman’s garment: 4 all dat do so r abomination 2 tha LORD ur God.

If a bird’s nest chance 2 be before u in tha way in any tree, or on tha ground, whether dey be young ones, or eggs, N tha dam sittin upon tha young, or upon tha eggs, u will not take tha dam wit tha young:
But u will in any wise let tha dam go, N take tha young 2 u; dat it may be well wit u, N dat u may prolong ur days.
When u build a new house, then u will make a battlement 4 ur roof, dat u bring not blood upon thine house, if any man fall from thence.
u will not sow ur vineyard wit divers seeds: lest tha fruit of ur seed which u have sown, N tha fruit of ur vineyard, be defiled.
u will not plow wit an ox N an ass together.
u will not wear a garment of divers sorts, as of woollen N linen together.
u will make u fringes upon tha four quarters of ur vesture, wherewith u cover urself.
If any man take a wife, N go in 2 her, N hate her,
N give occasions of speech against her, N bring up an evil name upon her, N say, I took dis woman, N when I came 2 her, I found her not a maid:
Then shall tha father of tha damsel, N her mother, take N bring forth tha tokens of tha damsel’s virginity 2 tha elders of tha city in tha gate:
N tha damsel’s father shall say 2 tha elders, I gave my daughter 2 dis man 2 wife, N he hates her;

N, look, he has given occasions of speech against her, sayin, I found not ur daughter a maid; N yet dese r tha tokens of my daughter’s virginity. N dey shall spread tha cloth before tha elders of tha city.
N tha elders of dat city shall take dat man N chastise him;

N dey shall amerce him in an hundred shekels of silver, N give ’em 2 tha father of tha damsel, because he has brought up an evil name upon a virgin of Israel: N she shall be his wife; he may not put her away all his days.
But if dis thing be true, N tha tokens of virginity don’t be found 4 tha damsel:

Then dey shall bring out tha damsel 2 tha door of her father’s house, N tha men of her city shall stone her wit stones dat she die: because she has wrought folly in Israel, 2 play tha whore in her father’s house: so will u put evil away from among u.
If a man be found lyin wit a woman married 2 an husband, then dey shall both of ’em die, both tha man dat lay wit tha woman, N tha woman: so will u put away evil from Israel.
If a damsel dat is a virgin be betrothed 2 an husband, N a man find her in tha city, N lie wit her;

Then y’all shall bring ’em both out 2 tha gate of dat city, N y’all shall stone ’em wit stones dat dey die; tha damsel, because she cried not, bein in tha city; N tha man, because he has humbled his neighbour’s wife: so u will put away evil from among u.
But if a man find a betrothed damsel in tha field, N tha man force her, N lie wit her: then tha man only dat lay wit her shall die:
But 2 tha damsel u will do nothing; there is in tha damsel no sin worthy of death: 4 as when a man rises against his neighbour, N slayeth him, even so is dis matter:
4 he found her in tha field, N tha betrothed damsel cried, N there was none 2 save her.
If a man find a damsel dat is a virgin, which is not betrothed, N lay hold on her, N lie wit her, N dey be found;
Then tha man dat lay wit her shall give 2 tha damsel’s father fifty shekels of silver, N she shall be his wife; because he has humbled her, he may not put her away all his days.
A man shall not take his father’s wife, nor discover his father’s skirt.

23.text: He dat is wounded in tha stones, or has his privy member cut off, shall not enter in2 tha congregation of tha LORD.
A bastard shall not enter in2 tha congregation of tha LORD; even 2 his tenth generation shall he not enter in2 tha congregation of tha LORD.
An Ammonite or Moabite shall not enter in2 tha congregation of tha LORD; even 2 their tenth generation shall dey not enter in2 tha congregation of tha LORD 4 ever:
Because dey met u not wit bread N wit water in tha way, when y’all came forth out of Egypt; N because dey hired against u Balaam tha son of Beor of Pethor of Mesopotamia, 2 curse u.
Nevertheless tha LORD ur God would not listen 2 Balaam; but tha LORD ur God turned tha curse in2 a blessing 2 u, because tha LORD ur God loved u.
u will not seek their peace nor their prosperity all ur days 4 ever.
u will not abhor an Edomite; 4 he is ur brother: u will not abhor an Egyptian; because u were a stranger in his land.
Tha children dat r begotten of ’em shall enter in2 tha congregation of tha LORD in their third generation.
When tha host goes forth against thine opps, then keep u from every wicked thing.
If there be among u any man, dat is not clean by reason of uncleanness dat chanceth him by night, then shall he go abroad out of tha camp, he shall not come within tha camp:
But it shall be, when evening comes on, he shall wash himself wit water: N when tha sun is down, he shall come in2 tha camp again.
u will have a place also without tha camp, where u will go forth abroad:
N u will have a paddle upon ur weapon; N it will be, when u will ease urself abroad, u will dig wit it, N will turn back N cover dat which comes from u:
4 tha LORD ur God walks in tha midst of ur camp, 2 deliver u, N 2 give up thine opps before u; therefore shall ur camp be holy: dat he see no unclean thing in u, N turn away from u.
u will not deliver 2 his master tha servant which is escaped from his master 2 u:
He shall live wit u, even among u, in dat place which he shall choose in one of ur gates, where it liketh him best: u will not oppress him.
There shall be no whore of tha daughters of Israel, nor a sodomite of tha sons of Israel.
u will not bring tha hire of a whore, or tha price of a dog, in2 tha house of tha LORD ur God 4 any vow: 4 even both dese r abomination 2 tha LORD ur God.
u will not lend upon usury 2 ur brother; usury of money, usury of food, usury of any thing dat is lent upon usury:
2 a stranger u may lend upon usury; but 2 ur brother u will not lend upon usury: dat tha LORD ur God may bless u in all dat u set thine hand 2 in tha land where u go 2 possess it.
When u will vow a vow 2 tha LORD ur God, u will not slack 2 pay it: 4 tha LORD ur God will surely require it of u; N it would be sin in u.
But if u will forbear 2 vow, it shall be no sin in u.
Dat which is gone out of ur lips u will keep N perform; even a freewill offering, according as u have vowed 2 tha LORD ur God, which u have promised wit ur mouth.
When u come in2 ur neighbour’s vineyard, then u may eat grapes ur fill at ur own pleasure; but u will not put any in ur vessel.
When u come in2 tha standin corn of ur neighbour, then u may pluck tha ears wit thine hand; but u will not move a sickle 2 ur neighbour’s standin corn.

24.text: When a man has taken a wife, N married her, N it come 2 pass dat she find no favour in his eyes, because he has found some uncleanness in her: then let him write her a bill of divorcement, N give it in her hand, N send her out of his house.
N when she is departed out of his house, she may go N be another man’s wife.
N if tha latter husband hate her, N write her a bill of divorcement, N gives it in her hand, N sends her out of his house; or if tha latter husband die, which took her 2 be his wife;

Her former husband, which sent her away, may not take her again 2 be his wife, after dat she is defiled; 4 dat is abomination before tha LORD: N u will not cause tha land 2 sin, which tha LORD ur God gives u 4 an inheritance.
When a man has taken a new wife, he shall not go out 2 war, neither shall he be charged wit any business: but he shall be free at home one year, N shall cheer up his wife which he has taken.
No man shall take tha nether or tha upper millstone 2 pledge: 4 he takes a man’s life 2 pledge.
If a man be found stealing any of his brothers of tha children of Israel, N makes merchandise of him, or sells him; then dat thief shall die; N u will put evil away from among u.
Pay attention in tha plague of leprosy, dat u observe diligently, N do according 2 all dat tha priests tha Levites shall teach u: as I commanded ’em, so y’all shall observe 2 do.
Remember what tha LORD ur God did 2 Miriam by tha way, after dat y’all were come forth out of Egypt.
When u do lend ur brother any thing, u will not go in2 his house 2 fetch his pledge.
u will stand abroad, N tha man 2 whom u do lend shall bring out tha pledge abroad 2 u.
N if tha man be poor, u will not sleep wit his pledge:
In any case u will deliver him tha pledge again when tha sun goes down, dat he may sleep in his own clothing, N bless u: N it will be righteousness 2 u before tha LORD ur God.
u will not oppress an hired servant dat is poor N needy, whether he be of ur brothers, or of ur strangers dat r in ur land within ur gates:
At his day u will give him his hire, neither shall tha sun go down upon it; 4 he is poor, N sets his heart upon it: lest he cry against u 2 tha LORD, N it be sin 2 u.
Tha fathers shall not be put 2 death 4 tha children, neither shall tha children be put 2 death 4 tha fathers: every man shall be put 2 death 4 his own sin.
u will not pervert tha judgment of tha stranger, nor of tha fatherless; nor take a widow’s clothing 2 pledge:
But u will remember dat u were a bondman in Egypt, N tha LORD ur God redeemed u thence: therefore I command u 2 do dis thing.

When u cut down thine harvest in ur field, N have forgot a sheaf in tha field, u will not go again 2 fetch it: it shall be 4 tha stranger, 4 tha fatherless, N 4 tha widow: dat tha LORD ur God may bless u in all tha work of thine hands.
When u beatest thine olive tree, u will not go over tha boughs again: it shall be 4 tha stranger, 4 tha fatherless, N 4 tha widow.
When u gather tha grapes of ur vineyard, u will not glean it afterward: it shall be 4 tha stranger, 4 tha fatherless, N 4 tha widow.
N u will remember dat u were a bondman in tha land of Egypt: therefore I command u 2 do dis thing.

25.text: If there be a controversy between men, N dey come 2 judgment, dat tha judges may judge ’em; then dey shall justify tha righteous, N condemn tha wicked.
N it will be, if tha wicked man be worthy 2 be beaten, dat tha judge shall cause him 2 lie down, N 2 be beaten before his face, according 2 his fault, by a certain number.
Forty stripes he may give him, N not exceed: lest, if he should exceed, N beat him above dese wit many stripes, then ur brother should seem vile 2 u.
u will not muzzle tha ox when he treads out tha corn.

If brothers live together, N one of ’em die, N have no child, tha wife of tha dead shall not marry without 2 a stranger: her husband’s brother shall go in 2 her, N take her 2 him 2 wife, N perform tha duty of an husband’s brother 2 her.
N it will be, dat tha firstborn which she bears shall succeed in tha name of his brother which is dead, dat his name don’t be put out of Israel.

N if tha man like not 2 take his brother’s wife, then let his brother’s wife go up 2 tha gate 2 tha elders, N say, My husband’s brother refuses 2 raise up 2 his brother a name in Israel, he will not perform tha duty of my husband’s brother.
Then tha elders of his city shall call him, N speak 2 him: N if he stand 2 it, N say, I like not 2 take her;

Then shall his brother’s wife come 2 him in tha presence of tha elders, N loose his shoe from off his foot, N spit in his face, N shall answer N say, So shall it be done 2 dat man dat will not build up his brother’s house.
N his name shall be called in Israel, tha house of him dat has his shoe loosed.
When men strive together one wit another, N tha wife of tha one draws near 4 2 deliver her husband out of tha hand of him dat strikes him, N puts forth her hand, N takes him by tha secrets:
Then u will cut off her hand, thine eye shall not pity her.
u will not have in ur bag divers weights, a great N a small.
u will not have in thine house divers measures, a great N a small.
But u will have a perfect N just weight, a perfect N just measure will u have: dat ur days may be lengthened in tha land which tha LORD ur God gives u.
4 all dat do such things, N all dat do unrighteously, r an abomination 2 tha LORD ur God.
Remember what Amalek did 2 u by tha way, when y’all were come forth out of Egypt;
How he met u by tha way, N struck tha hindmost of u, even all dat were feeble behind u, when u were faint N weary; N he feared not God.

Therefore it shall be, when tha LORD ur God has given u rest from all thine opps round about, in tha land which tha LORD ur God gives u 4 an inheritance 2 possess it, dat u will blot out tha remembrance of Amalek from under heaven; u will not forget it.

26.text: N it will be, when u r come in 2 tha land which tha LORD ur God gives u 4 an inheritance, N possessest it, N dwell in it;

Dat u will take of tha first of all tha fruit of tha earth, which u will bring of ur land dat tha LORD ur God gives u, N will put it in a basket, N will go 2 tha place which tha LORD ur God shall choose 2 place his name there.
N u will go 2 tha priest dat shall be in dose days, N say 2 him, I profess dis day 2 tha LORD ur God, dat I am come 2 tha country which tha LORD sware 2 our fathers 4 2 give us.
N tha priest shall take tha basket out of thine hand, N set it down before tha altar of tha LORD ur God.
N u will speak N say before tha LORD ur God, A Syrian ready 2 perish was my father, N he went down in2 Egypt, N stayed there wit a few, N became there a nation, great, mighty, N populous:
N tha Egyptians evil entreated us, N afflicted us, N laid upon us hard bondage:
N when we cried 2 tha LORD God of our fathers, tha LORD heard our voice, N looked on our affliction, N our labour, N our oppression:
N tha LORD brought us forth out of Egypt wit a mighty hand, N wit an outstretched arm, N wit great terribleness, N wit signs, N wit wonders:
N he has brought us in2 dis place, N has given us dis land, even a land dat flows wit milk N honey.
N now, look, I have brought tha firstfruits of tha land, which u, O LORD, have given me. N u will set it before tha LORD ur God, N worship before tha LORD ur God:
N u will rejoice in every good thing which tha LORD ur God has given 2 u, N 2 thine house, u, N tha Levite, N tha stranger dat is among u.

When u have made an end of tithing all tha tithes of thine increase tha third year, which is tha year of tithing, N have given it 2 tha Levite, tha stranger, tha fatherless, N tha widow, dat dey may eat within ur gates, N be filled;

Then u will say before tha LORD ur God, I have brought away tha hallowed things out of mine house, N also have given ’em 2 tha Levite, N 2 tha stranger, 2 tha fatherless, N 2 tha widow, according 2 all ur commandments which u have commanded me: I have not transgressed ur commandments, neither have I forgotten ’em:

I have not eaten of it in my mournin, neither have I taken away ought of it 4 any unclean use, nor given ought of it 4 tha dead: but I have listened 2 tha voice of tha LORD my God, N have done according 2 all dat u have commanded me.
Look down from ur holy habitation, from heaven, N bless ur people Israel, N tha land which u have given us, as u swarest 2 our fathers, a land dat flows wit milk N honey.
Dis day tha LORD ur God has commanded u 2 do dese statutes N judgments: u will therefore keep N do ’em wit all thine heart, N wit all ur soul.
u have avouched tha LORD dis day 2 be ur God, N 2 walk in his ways, N 2 keep his statutes, N his commandments, N his judgments, N 2 listen 2 his voice:
N tha LORD has avouched u dis day 2 be his peculiar people, as he has promised u, N dat u should keep all his commandments;
N 2 make u high above all nations which he has made, in praise, N in name, N in honour; N dat u may be an holy people 2 tha LORD ur God, as he has spoken.

27.text: N Moses wit tha elders of Israel commanded tha people, sayin, Keep all tha commandments which I command u dis day.
N it will be on tha day when y’all shall pass over Jordan 2 tha land which tha LORD ur God gives u, dat u will set u up great stones, N plaister ’em wit plaister:

N u will write upon ’em all tha words of dis law, when u r passed over, dat u may go in 2 tha land which tha LORD ur God gives u, a land dat flows wit milk N honey; as tha LORD God of ur fathers has promised u.
Therefore it shall be when y’all be gone over Jordan, dat y’all shall set up dese stones, which I command u dis day, in mount Ebal, N u will plaister ’em wit plaister.
N there will u build an altar 2 tha LORD ur God, an altar of stones: u will not lift up any iron tool upon ’em.
u will build tha altar of tha LORD ur God of whole stones: N u will offer burnt offerings thereon 2 tha LORD ur God:
N u will offer peace offerings, N will eat there, N rejoice before tha LORD ur God.
N u will write upon tha stones all tha words of dis law very plainly.
N Moses N tha priests tha Levites spoke 2 all Israel, sayin, pay attention, N listen, O Israel; dis day u r become tha people of tha LORD ur God.
u will therefore obey tha voice of tha LORD ur God, N do his commandments N his statutes, which I command u dis day.
N Moses charged tha people tha same day, sayin,
Dese shall stand upon mount Gerizim 2 bless tha people, when y’all r come over Jordan; Simeon, N Levi, N Judah, N Issachar, N Joseph, N Benjamin:
N dese shall stand upon mount Ebal 2 curse; Reuben, Gad, N Asher, N Zebulun, Dan, N Naphtali.
N tha Levites shall speak, N say 2 all tha men of Israel wit a loud voice,
Cursed be tha man dat makes any graven or molten image, an abomination 2 tha LORD, tha work of tha hands of tha craftsman, N puts it in a secret place. N all tha people shall answer N say, Amen.
Cursed be he dat sets light by his father or his mother. N all tha people shall say, Amen.
Cursed be he dat removeth his neighbour’s landmark. N all tha people shall say, Amen.
Cursed be he dat makes tha blind 2 wander out of tha way. N all tha people shall say, Amen.
Cursed be he dat perverteth tha judgment of tha stranger, fatherless, N widow. N all tha people shall say, Amen.
Cursed be he dat lies wit his father’s wife; because he uncovereth his father’s skirt. N all tha people shall say, Amen.
Cursed be he dat lies wit any manner of beast. N all tha people shall say, Amen.
Cursed be he dat lies wit his sister, tha daughter of his father, or tha daughter of his mother. N all tha people shall say, Amen.
Cursed be he dat lies wit his mother in law. N all tha people shall say, Amen.
Cursed be he dat strikes his neighbour secretly. N all tha people shall say, Amen.
Cursed be he dat takes reward 2 kill an innocent person. N all tha people shall say, Amen.
Cursed be he dat confirmeth not all tha words of dis law 2 do ’em. N all tha people shall say, Amen.

28.text: N it will happen, if u will listen diligently 2 tha voice of tha LORD ur God, 2 observe N 2 do all his commandments which I command u dis day, dat tha LORD ur God will set u on high above all nations of tha earth:
N all dese blessings shall come on u, N overtake u, if u will listen 2 tha voice of tha LORD ur God.
Blessed will u be in tha city, N blessed will u be in tha field.
Blessed shall be tha fruit of ur body, N tha fruit of ur ground, N tha fruit of ur cattle, tha increase of ur kine, N tha flocks of ur sheep.
Blessed shall be ur basket N ur store.
Blessed will u be when u come in, N blessed will u be when u go out.
Tha LORD shall cause thine opps dat rise up against u 2 be struck before ur face: dey shall come out against u one way, N flee before u seven ways.
Tha LORD shall command tha blessing upon u in ur storehouses, N in all dat u set thine hand 2; N he shall bless u in tha land which tha LORD ur God gives u.
Tha LORD shall establish u an holy people 2 himself, as he has sworn 2 u, if u will keep tha commandments of tha LORD ur God, N walk in his ways.
N all people of tha earth shall see dat u r called by tha name of tha LORD; N dey shall be afraid of u.
N tha LORD shall make u plenteous in goods, in tha fruit of ur body, N in tha fruit of ur cattle, N in tha fruit of ur ground, in tha land which tha LORD sware 2 ur fathers 2 give u.
Tha LORD shall open 2 u his good treasure, tha heaven 2 give tha rain 2 ur land in his season, N 2 bless all tha work of thine hand: N u will lend 2 many nations, N u will not borrow.

N tha LORD shall make u tha head, N not tha tail; N u will be above only, N u will not be beneath; if dat u listen 2 tha commandments of tha LORD ur God, which I command u dis day, 2 observe N 2 do ’em:
N u will not go aside from any of tha words which I command u dis day, 2 tha right hand, or 2 tha left, 2 go after other gods 2 serve ’em.

But it will happen, if u will not listen 2 tha voice of tha LORD ur God, 2 observe 2 do all his commandments N his statutes which I command u dis day; dat all dese curses shall come upon u, N overtake u:
Cursed will u be in tha city, N cursed will u be in tha field.
Cursed shall be ur basket N ur store.
Cursed shall be tha fruit of ur body, N tha fruit of ur land, tha increase of ur kine, N tha flocks of ur sheep.
Cursed will u be when u come in, N cursed will u be when u go out.

Tha LORD shall send upon u cursing, vexation, N rebuke, in all dat u set thine hand 2 4 2 do, until u be destroyed, N until u perish quickly; because of tha wickedness of ur doings, whereby u have forsaken me.
Tha LORD shall make tha pestilence cleave 2 u, until he have consumed u from off tha land, where u go 2 possess it.
Tha LORD shall strike u wit a consumption, N wit a fever, N wit an inflammation, N wit an extreme burnin, N wit tha sword, N wit blasting, N wit mildew; N dey shall pursue u until u perish.
N ur heaven dat is over ur head shall be brass, N tha earth dat is under u shall be iron.
Tha LORD shall make tha rain of ur land powder N dust: from heaven shall it come down upon u, until u be destroyed.
Tha LORD shall cause u 2 be struck before thine opps: u will go out one way against ’em, N flee seven ways before ’em: N will be removed in2 all tha kingdoms of tha earth.
N ur carcase shall be food 2 all fowls of tha air, N 2 tha beasts of tha earth, N no man shall fray ’em away.
Tha LORD will strike u wit tha botch of Egypt, N wit tha emerods, N wit tha scab, N wit tha itch, whereof u can not be healed.
Tha LORD shall strike u wit madness, N blindness, N astonishment of heart:
N u will grope at noonday, as tha blind gropeth in darkness, N u will not prosper in ur ways: N u will be only oppressed N spoiled evermore, N no man shall save u.
u will betroth a wife, N another man shall lie wit her: u will build an house, N u will not live in it: u will plant a vineyard, N will not gather tha grapes of it.

Thine ox shall be killed before ur eyes, N u will not eat of it: thine ass shall be violently taken away from before ur face, N shall not be restored 2 u: ur sheep shall be given 2 thine opps, N u will have none 2 rescue ’em.
Ur sons N ur daughters shall be given 2 another people, N ur eyes shall look, N fail wit longing 4 ’em all tha day long: N there shall be no might in thine hand.
Tha fruit of ur land, N all ur labours, shall a nation which u know not eat up; N u will be only oppressed N crushed alway:
So dat u will be mad 4 tha sight of ur eyes which u will see.
Tha LORD shall strike u in tha knees, N in tha legs, wit a sore botch dat cannot be healed, from tha sole of ur foot 2 tha top of ur head.
Tha LORD shall bring u, N ur king which u will set over u, 2 a nation which neither u nor ur fathers have known; N there will u serve other gods, wood N stone.
N u will become an astonishment, a proverb, N a byword, among all nations where tha LORD shall lead u.
u will carry much seed out in2 tha field, N will gather but little in; 4 tha locust shall consume it.
u will plant vineyards, N dress ’em, but will neither drink of tha wine, nor gather tha grapes; 4 tha worms shall eat ’em.
u will have olive trees throughout all ur coasts, but u will not anoint urself wit tha oil; 4 thine olive shall cast his fruit.
u will beget sons N daughters, but u will not enjoy ’em; 4 dey shall go in2 captivity.
All ur trees N fruit of ur land shall tha locust consume.
Tha stranger dat is within u shall get up above u very high; N u will come down very low.
He shall lend 2 u, N u will not lend 2 him: he shall be tha head, N u will be tha tail.

Moreover all dese curses shall come upon u, N shall pursue u, N overtake u, till u be destroyed; because u hearkenedst not 2 tha voice of tha LORD ur God, 2 keep his commandments N his statutes which he commanded u:
N dey shall be upon u 4 a sign N 4 a wonder, N upon ur seed 4 ever.
Because u servedst not tha LORD ur God wit joyfulness, N wit gladness of heart, 4 tha abundance of all things;

Therefore will u serve thine opps which tha LORD shall send against u, in hunger, N in thirst, N in nakedness, N in want of all things: N he shall put a yoke of iron upon ur neck, until he have destroyed u.
Tha LORD shall bring a nation against u from far, from tha end of tha earth, as swift as tha eagle flieth; a nation whose tongue u will not understand;
A nation of fierce countenance, which shall not regard tha person of tha old, nor show favour 2 tha young:

N he shall eat tha fruit of ur cattle, N tha fruit of ur land, until u be destroyed: which also shall not leave u either corn, wine, or oil, or tha increase of ur kine, or flocks of ur sheep, until he have destroyed u.

N he shall besiege u in all ur gates, until ur high N fenced walls come down, in which u trustedst, throughout all ur land: N he shall besiege u in all ur gates throughout all ur land, which tha LORD ur God has given u.
N u will eat tha fruit of ur own body, tha flesh of ur sons N of ur daughters, which tha LORD ur God has given u, in tha siege, N in tha straitness, wherewith thine opps shall distress u:
So dat tha man dat is tender among u, N very delicate, his eye shall be evil toward his brother, N toward tha wife of his bosom, N toward tha remnant of his children which he shall leave:

So dat he will not give 2 any of ’em of tha flesh of his children whom he shall eat: because he has nothing left him in tha siege, N in tha straitness, wherewith thine opps shall distress u in all ur gates.

Tha tender N delicate woman among u, which would not adventure 2 set tha sole of her foot upon tha ground 4 delicateness N tenderness, her eye shall be evil toward tha husband of her bosom, N toward her son, N toward her daughter,

N toward her young one dat comes out from between her feet, N toward her children which she shall bear: 4 she shall eat ’em 4 want of all things secretly in tha siege N straitness, wherewith thine opp shall distress u in ur gates.
If u will not observe 2 do all tha words of dis law dat r written in dis book, dat u may fear dis glorious N fearful name, tha LORD ur GOD;
Then tha LORD will make ur plagues wonderful, N tha plagues of ur seed, even great plagues, N of long continuance, N sore sicknesses, N of long continuance.
Moreover he will bring upon u all tha diseases of Egypt, which u were afraid of; N dey shall cleave 2 u.
Also every sickness, N every plague, which is not written in tha book of dis law, ’em will tha LORD bring upon u, until u be destroyed.
N y’all shall be left few in number, whereas y’all were as tha stars of heaven 4 crowd; because u would not obey tha voice of tha LORD ur God.

N it will happen, dat as tha LORD rejoiced over u 2 do u good, N 2 multiply u; so tha LORD will rejoice over u 2 destroy u, N 2 bring u 2 nothing; N y’all shall be plucked from off tha land where u go 2 possess it.
N tha LORD shall scatter u among all people, from tha one end of tha earth even 2 tha other; N there u will serve other gods, which neither u nor ur fathers have known, even wood N stone.
N among dese nations will u find no ease, neither shall tha sole of ur foot have rest: but tha LORD shall give u there a tremblin heart, N failing of eyes, N sorrow of mind:
N ur life shall hang in doubt before u; N u will fear day N night, N will have none assurance of ur life:
In tha morning u will say, Would God it were even! N at even u will say, Would God it were morning! 4 tha fear of thine heart wherewith u will fear, N 4 tha sight of ur eyes which u will see.
N tha LORD shall bring u in2 Egypt again wit ships, by tha way whereof I spoke 2 u, u will see it no more again: N there y’all shall be sold 2 ur opps 4 bondmen N bondwomen, N no man shall buy u.

29.text: Dese r tha words of tha covenant, which tha LORD commanded Moses 2 make wit tha children of Israel in tha land of Moab, beside tha covenant which he made wit ’em in Horeb.
N Moses called 2 all Israel, N said 2 ’em, y’all have seen all dat tha LORD did before ur eyes in tha land of Egypt 2 Pharaoh, N 2 all his servants, N 2 all his land;
Tha great temptations which ur eyes have seen, tha signs, N dose great miracles:
Yet tha LORD has not given u an heart 2 perceive, N eyes 2 see, N ears 2 hear, 2 dis day.
N I have led u forty years in tha wilderness: ur clothes r not waxen old upon u, N ur shoe is not waxen old upon ur foot.
y’all have not eaten bread, neither have y’all drunk wine or strong drink: dat y’all might know dat I am tha LORD ur God.
N when y’all came 2 dis place, Sihon tha king of Heshbon, N Og tha king of Bashan, came out against us 2 battle, N we struck ’em:
N we took their land, N gave it 4 an inheritance 2 tha Reubenites, N 2 tha Gadites, N 2 tha half tribe of Manasseh.
Keep therefore tha words of dis covenant, N do ’em, dat y’all may prosper in all dat y’all do.
y’all stand dis day all of u before tha LORD ur God; ur captains of ur tribes, ur elders, N ur officers, wit all tha men of Israel,
Ur little ones, ur wives, N ur stranger dat is in ur camp, from tha hewer of ur wood 2 tha drawer of ur water:
Dat u should enter in2 covenant wit tha LORD ur God, N in2 his oath, which tha LORD ur God makes wit u dis day:
Dat he may establish u 2 day 4 a people 2 himself, N dat he may be 2 u a God, as he has said 2 u, N as he has sworn 2 ur fathers, 2 Abraham, 2 Isaac, N 2 Jacob.
Neither wit u only do I make dis covenant N dis oath;
But wit him dat stands here wit us dis day before tha LORD our God, N also wit him dat is not here wit us dis day:
(4 y’all know how we have lived in tha land of Egypt; N how we came through tha nations which y’all passed by;
N y’all have seen their abominations, N their idols, wood N stone, silver N gold, which were among ’em:)

Lest there should be among u man, or woman, or family, or tribe, whose heart turns away dis day from tha LORD our God, 2 go N serve tha gods of dese nations; lest there should be among u a root dat bears gall N wormwood;
N it come 2 pass, when he hears tha words of dis curse, dat he bless himself in his heart, sayin, I shall have peace, though I walk in tha imagination of mine heart, 2 add drunkenness 2 thirst:

Tha LORD will not spare him, but then tha anger of tha LORD N his jealousy shall smoke against dat man, N all tha curses dat r written in dis book shall lie upon him, N tha LORD shall blot out his name from under heaven.
N tha LORD shall separate him 2 evil out of all tha tribes of Israel, according 2 all tha curses of tha covenant dat r written in dis book of tha law:

So dat tha generation 2 come of ur children dat shall rise up after u, N tha stranger dat shall come from a far land, shall say, when dey see tha plagues of dat land, N tha sicknesses which tha LORD has laid upon it; has made it sick

N dat tha whole land of it is brimstone, N salt, N burnin, dat it is not sown, nor bears, nor any grass grows in it, like tha overthrow of Sodom, N Gomorrah, Admah, N Zeboim, which tha LORD overthrew in his anger, N in his wrath:
Even all nations shall say, so has tha LORD done like dis 2 dis land? what means tha heat of dis great anger?
Then men shall say, Because dey have forsaken tha covenant of tha LORD God of their fathers, which he made wit ’em when he brought ’em forth out of tha land of Egypt:
4 dey went N served other gods, N worshipped ’em, gods whom dey knew not, N whom he had not given 2 ’em:
N tha anger of tha LORD was kindled against dis land, 2 bring upon it all tha curses dat r written in dis book:
N tha LORD rooted ’em out of their land in anger, N in wrath, N in great indignation, N cast ’em in2 another land, as it is dis day.
Tha secret things belong 2 tha LORD our God: but dose things which r revealed belong 2 us N 2 our children 4 ever, dat we may do all tha words of dis law.

30.text: N it will happen, when all dese things r come upon u, tha blessing N tha curse, which I have set before u, N u will call ’em 2 mind among all tha nations, where tha LORD ur God has driven u,
N will return 2 tha LORD ur God, N will obey his voice according 2 all dat I command u dis day, u N ur children, wit all thine heart, N wit all ur soul;
Dat then tha LORD ur God will turn ur captivity, N have compassion upon u, N will return N gather u from all tha nations, where tha LORD ur God has scattered u.
If any of thine be driven out 2 tha outmost parts of heaven, from thence will tha LORD ur God gather u, N from thence will he fetch u:
N tha LORD ur God will bring u in2 tha land which ur fathers possessed, N u will possess it; N he will do u good, N multiply u above ur fathers.
N tha LORD ur God will circumcise thine heart, N tha heart of ur seed, 2 love tha LORD ur God wit all thine heart, N wit all ur soul, dat u may live.
N tha LORD ur God will put all dese curses upon thine opps, N on ’em dat hate u, which persecuted u.
N u will return N obey tha voice of tha LORD, N do all his commandments which I command u dis day.

N tha LORD ur God will make u plenteous in every work of thine hand, in tha fruit of ur body, N in tha fruit of ur cattle, N in tha fruit of ur land, 4 good: 4 tha LORD will again rejoice over u 4 good, as he rejoiced over ur fathers:
If u will listen 2 tha voice of tha LORD ur God, 2 keep his commandments N his statutes which r written in dis book of tha law, N if u turn 2 tha LORD ur God wit all thine heart, N wit all ur soul.
4 dis commandment which I command u dis day, it is not hidden from u, neither is it far off.
It is not in heaven, dat u should say, Who shall go up 4 us 2 heaven, N bring it 2 us, dat we may hear it, N do it?
Neither is it beyond tha sea, dat u should say, Who shall go over tha sea 4 us, N bring it 2 us, dat we may hear it, N do it?
But tha word is very nigh 2 u, in ur mouth, N in ur heart, dat u may do it.
See, I have set before u dis day life N good, N death N evil;

In dat I command u dis day 2 love tha LORD ur God, 2 walk in his ways, N 2 keep his commandments N his statutes N his judgments, dat u may live N multiply: N tha LORD ur God shall bless u in tha land where u go 2 possess it.
But if thine heart turn away, so dat u will not hear, but will be drawn away, N worship other gods, N serve ’em;
I denounce 2 u dis day, dat y’all shall surely perish, N dat y’all shall not prolong ur days upon tha land, where u pass over Jordan 2 go 2 possess it.
I call heaven N earth 2 record dis day against u, dat I have set before u life N death, blessing N cursing: therefore choose life, dat both u N ur seed may live:

Dat u may love tha LORD ur God, N dat u may obey his voice, N dat u may cleave 2 him: 4 he is ur life, N tha length of ur days: dat u may live in tha land which tha LORD sware 2 ur fathers, 2 Abraham, 2 Isaac, N 2 Jacob, 2 give ’em.

31.text: N Moses went N spoke dese words 2 all Israel.
N he said 2 ’em, I am an hundred N twenty years old dis day; I can no more go out N come in: also tha LORD has said 2 me, u will not go over dis Jordan.
Tha LORD ur God, he will go over before u, N he will destroy dese nations from before u, N u will possess ’em: N Joshua, he shall go over before u, as tha LORD has said.
N tha LORD shall do 2 ’em as he did 2 Sihon N 2 Og, kings of tha Amorites, N 2 tha land of ’em, whom he destroyed.
N tha LORD shall give ’em up before ur face, dat y’all may do 2 ’em according 2 all tha commandments which I have commanded u.
Be strong N of a good courage, don’t fear, nor be afraid of ’em: 4 tha LORD ur God, he it is dat does go wit u; he will not fail u, nor forsake u.

N Moses called 2 Joshua, N said 2 him in tha sight of all Israel, Be strong N of a good courage: 4 u must go wit dis people 2 tha land which tha LORD has sworn 2 their fathers 2 give ’em; N u will cause ’em 2 inherit it.
N tha LORD, he it is dat does go before u; he will be wit u, he will not fail u, neither forsake u: don’t fear, neither be dismayed.
N Moses wrote dis law, N delivered it 2 tha priests tha sons of Levi, which bare tha ark of tha covenant of tha LORD, N 2 all tha elders of Israel.
N Moses commanded ’em, sayin, At tha end of every seven years, in tha solemnity of tha year of release, in tha feast of tabernacles,
When all Israel is come 2 appear before tha LORD ur God in tha place which he shall choose, u will read dis law before all Israel in their hearin.
Gather tha people together, men, N women, N children, N ur stranger dat is within ur gates, dat dey may hear, N dat dey may learn, N fear tha LORD ur God, N observe 2 do all tha words of dis law:
N dat their children, which have not known any thing, may hear, N learn 2 fear tha LORD ur God, as long as y’all live in tha land where y’all go over Jordan 2 possess it.

N tha LORD said 2 Moses, look, ur days approach dat u must die: call Joshua, N present y’all in tha tabernacle of tha congregation, dat I may give him a charge. N Moses N Joshua went, N presented themselves in tha tabernacle of tha congregation.
N tha LORD appeared in tha tabernacle in a pillar of a cloud: N tha pillar of tha cloud stood over tha door of tha tabernacle.

N tha LORD said 2 Moses, look, u will sleep wit ur fathers; N dis people will rise up, N go a whoring after tha gods of tha strangers of tha land, where dey go 2 be among ’em, N will forsake me, N break my covenant which I have made wit ’em.

Then my anger shall be kindled against ’em in dat day, N I will forsake ’em, N I will hide my face from ’em, N dey shall be devoured, N many evils N troubles shall befall ’em; so dat dey will say in dat day, r not dese evils come upon us, because our God is not among us?
N I will surely hide my face in dat day 4 all tha evils which dey shall have wrought, in dat dey r turned 2 other gods.
Now therefore write y’all dis song 4 u, N teach it tha children of Israel: put it in their mouths, dat dis song may be a witness 4 me against tha children of Israel.

4 when I shall have brought ’em in2 tha land which I sware 2 their fathers, dat flows wit milk N honey; N dey shall have eaten N filled themselves, N waxen fat; then will dey turn 2 other gods, N serve ’em, N provoke me, N break my covenant.

N it will happen, when many evils N troubles r befallen ’em, dat dis song shall testify against ’em as a witness; 4 it shall not be forgotten out of tha mouths of their seed: 4 I know their imagination which dey go about, even now, before I have brought ’em in2 tha land which I sware.
Moses therefore wrote dis song tha same day, N taught it tha children of Israel.
N he gave Joshua tha son of Nun a charge, N said, Be strong N of a good courage: 4 u will bring tha children of Israel in2 tha land which I sware 2 ’em: N I will be wit u.
N it happened, when Moses had made an end of writing tha words of dis law in a book, until dey were finished,
Dat Moses commanded tha Levites, which bare tha ark of tha covenant of tha LORD, sayin,
Take dis book of tha law, N put it in tha side of tha ark of tha covenant of tha LORD ur God, dat it may be there 4 a witness against u.
4 I know ur rebellion, N ur stiff neck: look, while I am yet alive wit u dis day, y’all have been rebellious against tha LORD; N how much more after my death?
Gather 2 me all tha elders of ur tribes, N ur officers, dat I may speak dese words in their ears, N call heaven N earth 2 record against ’em.

4 I know dat after my death y’all will utterly corrupt y’all, N turn aside from tha way which I have commanded u; N evil will befall u in tha latter days; because y’all will do evil in tha sight of tha LORD, 2 provoke him 2 anger through tha work of ur hands.
N Moses spoke in tha ears of all tha congregation of Israel tha words of dis song, until dey were ended.

32.text: Listen up, O y’all heavenz, N I will speak; N hear, O earth, tha words of my mouth.
My doctrine shall drop as tha rain, my speech shall distil as tha dew, as tha small rain upon tha tender herb, N as tha showers upon tha grass:
Because I will publish tha name of tha LORD: ascribe y’all greatness 2 our God.
He is tha Rock, his work is perfect: 4 all his ways r judgment: a God of truth N without iniquity, just N right is he.
Dey have corrupted themselves, their spot is not tha spot of his children: dey r a perverse N crooked generation.
Do y’all like dis requite tha LORD, O foolish people N unwise? is not he ur father dat has bought u? has he not made u, N established u?
Remember tha days of old, consider tha years of many generations: ask ur father, N he will show u; ur elders, N dey will tell u.
When tha most High divided 2 tha nations their inheritance, when he separated tha sons of Adam, he set tha bounds of tha people according 2 tha number of tha children of Israel.
4 tha LORD’s portion is his people; Jacob is tha lot of his inheritance.
He found him in a desert land, N in tha waste howling wilderness; he led him about, he instructed him, he kept him as tha apple of his eye.
As an eagle stirreth up her nest, fluttereth over her young, spreads abroad her wings, takes ’em, bears ’em on her wings:
So tha LORD alone did lead him, N there was no strange god wit him.
He made him ride on tha high places of tha earth, dat he might eat tha increase of tha fields; N he made him 2 suck honey out of tha rock, N oil out of tha flinty rock;

But Jeshurun grew fat, N kicked: u r waxen fat, u r grown thick, u r covered wit fatness; then he forsook God which made him, N lightly esteemed tha Rock of his salvation.
Dey provoked him 2 jealousy wit strange gods, wit abominations provoked dey him 2 anger.
Dey sacrificed 2 devils, not 2 God; 2 gods whom dey knew not, 2 new gods dat came newly up, whom ur fathers feared not.
Of tha Rock dat fathered u u r unmindful, N have forgotten God dat formed u.
N when tha LORD saw it, he abhorred ’em, because of tha provoking of his sons, N of his daughters.
N he said, I will hide my face from ’em, I will see what their end shall be: 4 dey r a very froward generation, children in whom is no faith.

Dey have moved me 2 jealousy wit dat which is not God; dey have provoked me 2 anger wit their vanities: N I will move ’em 2 jealousy wit dose which r not a people; I will provoke ’em 2 anger wit a foolish nation.
4 a fire is kindled in mine anger, N shall burn 2 tha lowest hell, N shall consume tha earth wit her increase, N set on fire tha foundations of tha mountains.
I will heap mischiefs upon ’em; I will spend mine arrows upon ’em.
Dey shall be burnt wit hunger, N devoured wit burnin heat, N wit bitter destruction: I will also send tha teeth of beasts upon ’em, wit tha poison of serpents of tha dust.
Tha sword without, N terror within, shall destroy both tha young man N tha virgin, tha suckling also wit tha man of gray hairs.
I said, I would scatter ’em in2 corners, I would make tha remembrance of ’em 2 cease from among men:
Were it not dat I feared tha wrath of tha opp, lest their adversaries should behave themselves strangely, N lest dey should say, Our hand is high, N tha LORD has not done all dis. has done
4 dey r a nation void of counsel, neither is there any understanding in ’em.
O dat dey were wise, dat dey understood dis, dat dey would consider their latter end!
How should one chase a thousand, N two put ten thousand 2 flight, except their Rock had sold ’em, N tha LORD had shut ’em up?
4 their rock is not as our Rock, even our opps themselves bein judges.
4 their vine is of tha vine of Sodom, N of tha fields of Gomorrah: their grapes r grapes of gall, their clusters r bitter:
Their wine is tha poison of dragons, N tha cruel venom of asps.
Is not dis laid up in store wit me, N sealed up among my treasures?
2 me belongs vengeance, N recompence; their foot shall slide in due time: 4 tha day of their calamity is at hand, N tha things dat shall come upon ’em make haste.
4 tha LORD shall judge his people, N repent himself 4 his servants, when he sees dat their power is gone, N there is none shut up, or left.
N he shall say, Where r their gods, their rock in whom dey trusted,
Which did eat tha fat of their sacrifices, N drank tha wine of their drink offerings? let ’em rise up N help u, N be ur protection.
See now dat I, even I, am he, N there is no god wit me: I kill, N I make alive; I wound, N I heal: neither is there any dat can deliver out of my hand.
4 I lift up my hand 2 heaven, N say, I live 4 ever.
If I whet my glittering sword, N mine hand take hold on judgment; I will render vengeance 2 mine opps, N will reward ’em dat hate me.
I will make mine arrows drunk wit blood, N my sword shall devour flesh; N dat wit tha blood of tha killed N of tha captives, from tha beginning of revenges upon tha opp.
Rejoice, O y’all nations, wit his people: 4 he will avenge tha blood of his servants, N will render vengeance 2 his adversaries, N will be merciful 2 his land, N 2 his people.
N Moses came N spoke all tha words of dis song in tha ears of tha people, he, N Hoshea tha son of Nun.
N Moses made an end of speakin all dese words 2 all Israel:
N he said 2 ’em, Set ur hearts 2 all tha words which I testify among u dis day, which y’all shall command ur children 2 observe 2 do, all tha words of dis law.
4 it is not a vain thing 4 u; because it is ur life: N through dis thing y’all shall prolong ur days in tha land, where y’all go over Jordan 2 possess it.
N tha LORD spoke 2 Moses dat selfsame day, sayin,
Get u up in2 dis mountain Abarim, 2 mount Nebo, which is in tha land of Moab, dat is over against Jericho; N look tha land of Canaan, which I give 2 tha children of Israel 4 a possession:
N die in tha mount where u go up, N be gathered 2 ur people; as Aaron ur brother died in mount Hor, N was gathered 2 his people:
Because y’all trespassed against me among tha children of Israel at tha waterz of Meribah-Kadesh, in tha wilderness of Zin; because y’all sanctified me not in tha midst of tha children of Israel.
Yet u will see tha land before u; but u will not go there 2 tha land which I give tha children of Israel.

33.text: N dis is tha blessing, wherewith Moses tha man of God blessed tha children of Israel before his death.
N he said, tha LORD came from Sinai, N rose up from Seir 2 ’em; he shined forth from mount Paran, N he came wit ten thousands of saints: from his right hand went a fiery law 4 ’em.

N he was king in Jeshurun, when tha heads of tha people N tha tribes of Israel were gathered together.

N dis is tha blessing of Judah: N he said, Hear, LORD, tha voice of Judah, N bring him 2 his people: let his hands be sufficient 4 him; N be u an help 2 him from his opps.
N of Levi he said, Let ur Thummim N ur Urim be wit ur holy one, whom u did prove at Massah, N wit whom u did strive at tha waterz of Meribah;
Who said 2 his father N 2 his mother, I have not seen him; neither did he acknowledge his brothers, nor knew his own children: 4 dey have observed ur word, N kept ur covenant.
Dey shall teach Jacob ur judgments, N Israel ur law: dey shall put incense before u, N whole burnt sacrifice upon thine altar.
Bless, LORD, his substance, N accept tha work of his hands: strike through tha loins of ’em dat rise against him, N of ’em dat hate him, dat dey rise not again.
N of Benjamin he said, tha beloved of tha LORD shall live in safety by him; N tha Lord shall cover him all tha day long, N he shall live between his shoulders.
N of Joseph he said, Blessed of tha LORD be his land, 4 tha precious things of heaven, 4 tha dew, N 4 tha deep dat coucheth beneath,
N 4 tha precious fruits brought forth by tha sun, N 4 tha precious things put forth by tha moon,
N 4 tha chief things of tha ancient mountains, N 4 tha precious things of tha lasting hills,

N 4 tha precious things of tha earth N fulness of it, N 4 tha good will of him dat lived in tha bush: let tha blessing come upon tha head of Joseph, N upon tha top of tha head of him dat was separated from his brothers.

His glory is like tha firstling of his bullock, N his horns r like tha horns of unicorns: wit ’em he shall push tha people together 2 tha ends of tha earth: N dey r tha ten thousands of Ephraim, N dey r tha thousands of Manasseh.
N of Zebulun he said, Rejoice, Zebulun, in ur goin out; N, Issachar, in ur tents.

N of Gad he said, Blessed be he dat enlargeth Gad: he lives as a lion, N tears tha arm wit tha crown of tha head.

N he provided tha first part 4 himself, because there, in a portion of tha lawgiver, was he seated; N he came wit tha heads of tha people, he executed tha justice of tha LORD, N his judgments wit Israel.
N of Dan he said, Dan is a lion’s whelp: he shall leap from Bashan.
N of Naphtali he said, O Naphtali, satisfied wit favour, N full wit tha blessing of tha LORD: possess u tha west N tha south.
N of Asher he said, Let Asher be blessed wit children; let him be acceptable 2 his brothers, N let him dip his foot in oil.

Happy r u, O Israel: who is like 2 u, O people saved by tha LORD, tha shield of ur help, N who is tha sword of ur excellency! N thine opps shall be found liars 2 u; N u will tread upon their high places.

34.text: N Moses went up from tha plains of Moab 2 tha mountain of Nebo, 2 tha top of Pisgah, dat is over against Jericho. N tha LORD showed him all tha land of Gilead, 2 Dan,
N all Naphtali, N tha land of Ephraim, N Manasseh, N all tha land of Judah, 2 tha utmost sea,
N tha south, N tha plain of tha valley of Jericho, tha city of palm trees, 2 Zoar.

N tha children of Israel wept 4 Moses in tha plains of Moab thirty days: so tha days of weepin N mournin 4 Moses were ended.
N Joshua tha son of Nun was full of tha spirit of wisdom; 4 Moses had laid his hands upon him: N tha children of Israel listened 2 him, N did as tha LORD commanded Moses.
N there arose not a prophet since in Israel like 2 Moses, whom tha LORD knew face 2 face,
In all tha signs N tha wonders, which tha LORD sent him 2 do in tha land of Egypt 2 Pharaoh, N 2 all his servants, N 2 all his land,
